Structural Geologist

The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world’s current and future energy challenges.  As one of the leading energy providers worldwide, Chevron is involved in the production of crude oil and natural gas, manufacturing of transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and additives, and the development of enabling technologies.

Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. With a clear purpose to develop affordable, reliable, ever-cleaner energy that enables human progress, we believe human ingenuity has the power to solve any challenge and overcome any obstacle. Meeting the world’s growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all.

About the position:

Chevron ENGINE is seeking highly qualified candidates to join our Earth Science group. The successful candidate will provide Structural Geology support for a variety of asset classes to support Earth Scientists and Technical Specialists both in ENGINE and internationally. There will be the potential to assist with technology development.

This is an early to mid-career position in the Chevron ENGINE Earth Science group for a knowledgeable Structural Geologist with an established work history, delivering high-quality structural characterization products that are utilized to evaluate the quality of trapping and sealing mechanisms for hydrocarbon reservoirs and provide critical insights for drilling operations and field management optimization efforts.

The role will directly support Chevron’s assets through complex reservoir management and exploration challenges while ensuring robust structural characterizations products. The candidate will support the development and optimization of structural interpretations and structural modeling workflows and provide direct inputs to Basin and Reservoir Modeling workflows. The candidate will communicate effectively with assets, services and research and development (R&D) teams to achieve technical objectives.

Key Responsibilities:

The position will be responsible for executing established structural interpretation and modeling workflows to evaluate structure, trap geometry and seal capacity of subsurface hydrocarbon reservoirs.

Closely collaborate with subject matter experts in Chevron Technical Center (CTC) in Houston, and colleagues co-located within ENGINE on topics related to structural geology.

Conduct detailed mapping of regional and local structural fault framework (2D and 3D) using seismic and well data to evaluate regional structural trends and delineate local trap geometry and evolution.

Generation of structural cross-sections, structural maps, and kinematic models to develop structural scenarios as input to reservoir and basin models.

Perform quality control on existing structural frameworks and examine the impact of structural uncertainty and fault framework linkage on trap geometry and compartmentalization.

Conduct fault and top seal evaluation to assess seal integrity and seal capacity through integration of seismic data, well logs and pressure data.

Perform reservoir connectivity analysis through evaluation of fault juxtaposition analysis and fault-rock property modeling.

Analyze structural features such as faults, folds, and fractures from wellbore image log interpretation, to assess their impact on reservoir quality and fluid flow in support of field development optimization.


Required Qualifications:

Possession of a M.Sc. or Ph.D. degree in Geology or Earth Science in one of the following disciplines: structural geology or basin analysis.

Required experience with Petrel (or equivalent modeling applications); familiarity with seismic interpretation and fault mapping, familiarity with advanced data analysis tools is beneficial.

Proven experience in fault framework analysis, generation of structural cross-sections and structural maps.

Prior relevant experience working with subsurface data and integrating multi-disciplinary datasets.

Experience in customer support, with an understanding of subsurface business needs, and the ability to collaborate effectively across different time zones.


Preferred Qualifications:

Basic knowledge of Geomechanics with focus on Stress and Strain analysis, Rock Mechanics, and Fluid Flow.  

Relevant prior experience in collaborating with other disciplines, in particular basin modeling, reservoir modeling, or reservoir engineering.

Relevant prior experience in at least one aspect of integrated reservoir characterization workflows (i.e., stratigraphy, reservoir quality, biostratigraphy, basin analysis).

Relevant experience with integrating Petrophysical datasets, with prior experience of Petrophysical platforms (Techlog) being advantageous but not required.

Prior experience with image log interpretation and post-interpretation analysis is advantageous but not required.

Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS):

About the position
The Geomechanics Fracturing Modeling Specialist will provide fracture modelling support to enhance shale & tight (S&T) recovery, reduce cost, optimize completion designs, enable safe fracturing operations, reduce environmental risk, and safeguard the system integrity & reliability. The position supports the construction, setup and execution of geomechanical model for hydraulic fracturing that are integral to S&T business unit (BU) activities. Strong knowledge in fracture mechanics is required. Extensive experience in geomechanics, stimulation and reservoir simulation is required. Advanced degree in geomechanics or related discipline is required. A functional knowledge of shale and tight operations, the role geomechanics plays in them, and geomechanics related business decisions is required. Background in development of 1D or 3D Mechanical Earth Models (MEM) is preferred. The role brings together working subsurface knowledge and expertise in a growing technical area with significant impact to shale & tight (unconventional) assets.  The role requires close collaboration with subject matter experts to maintain workflow alignment.

Key responsibilities

The position supports the construction, setup and execution of geomechanical model for hydraulic fracturing that are integral to S&T asset activities. Model construction and analyses are conducted to address geomechanical challenges for S&T assets such as: hydraulic fracturing, fracture height growth, drainage height assessment, fracture driven interaction, job optimization including well and cluster spacing, landing point optimization etc.
Populate hydraulic fracture models for S&T assets with geological and geophysical data, rock properties, pump schedules, fluid rheology and, relevant pressure and temperature conditions under collaboration with relevant subject matter experts.
Execute hydraulic fracture S&T models, extract relevant data and manage results repository.
Assess interactions between parent and child wells utilizing workflows that couple hydraulic fracture models, reservoir simulators and 4D MEM models.

About you 

 We know our greatest resource is the ingenuity, creativity and innovation of our people. Applications from motivated, talented individuals with a keen interest in the energy industry are encouraged. 

To be considered for this role, applicants should have: 

BS and MS in Earth science disciplines (Geology, Geophysics, Geomechanics) or Petroleum or equivalent Engineering
5-7 years of pertinent industry experience.
Experience in oil and gas industry
Experience in hands-on geomechanics hydraulic fracture modeling for S&T applications (e.g. Kinetix, ResFrac or equivalent software)
Experience with well operations and understanding of the interplay between subsurface conditions in unconventional assets and well performance.
Experienced in unconventional resources and proficient in a wide range of geomechanics analysis techniques to handle field and well data


Preferred Qualifications:

5-7 years of experience in geomechanics field
Experience in hydraulic fracture modeling software for shale and tight applications such as Kinetix, ResFrac or StimPlan
Experience in one dimensional well log software such as Techlog or Geolog
Experience in finite element solvers such as Abaqus, ParaGeo or Elfen

The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world’s current and future energy challenges.  As one of the leading energy providers worldwide, Chevron is involved in the production of crude oil and natural gas, manufacturing of transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and additives, and the development of enabling technologies.

Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. About the position

The I&E Reliability Engineer is a team member of the Reliability and Integrity organization within the Chevron ENGINE Center and provides I&E Reliability Engineering support to Chevron's Refining and Liquified Natural Gas (LNG) assets.   This role conducts the following types of activities. Maintenance Strategy Development through various reliability studies/tools, PM optimization, Refining Maintenance Work Instruction, Threat and Deficiency Process, Technical Query/Procurement Query for instruments, Replace in Kind assessments, Valve Health Monitoring, Performance Standard reviews and updates, maintenance queries and obsolescence review of I&E systems

Key responsibilities

Provide reliability  support to instrumentation and electrical assets within Chevron complex process facilities. 
Provide technical support on identifying and developing solutions for reliability threats and poor performing instrumentation and electrical assets.
Provide analytical support for reliability and integrity programs across the Chevron assets.
Support maintenance strategy development and improvement initiatives, develop & optimize maintenance strategies, develop and maintain maintenance procedures & processes, manage technical analysis of threats & procurement queries for instrument & electrical deficiencies, conduct replacement in kind (RIK) assessments, and perform valve health monitoring.
Work collaboratively with cross-functional teams (such as Operations, Technical, Routine Maintenance, Turnaround and Projects) to achieve the Reliability Engineering Team, department and asset goals to improve asset reliability.
 Support the facilitation and completion of Chevron reliability studies and capital projects.
 Supports the implementation of electrical asset strategies to enhance asset and equipment mechanical availability.
 Ensure compliance with applicable industry codes and standards as well as applicable Chevron standards, instructions, and guidelines.
 Support turnaround instrumentation and electrical scope development.
 Supports Management of Change (MOC) process to make instrumentation and electrical system performance, reliability and safety improvements.
 Facilitate the application and use of reliability tools and work processes to identify gaps, prioritize opportunities, and develop recommendations to improve asset performance and operational availability.
 Support the investigation and troubleshooting of instrumentation and electrical equipment failures through root cause analysis.
 Perform reliability analytics using statistical software to help determine probability of failure to prioritize maintenance work, justify spare parts stocking decisions, or develop options for selection of project alternatives.
Facilitate and perform different reliability studies like RCM/FMEA for Instrumentation and electrical assets .

About you

Experience with Company and industry I&E standard codes, design practices, and engineering standards/specifications in production facilities and field infrastructure.
 Ability to manage multiple initiatives schedules, manage costs and provide timely reliability recommendations in a fast-paced work environment.
Proven Knowledge in: Electrical Power Distribution Systems design, ETAP modeling. Power system analysis, including protective relaying, fast load shedding, etc. Including planning, operations, commissioning, start-up.  and maintenance of medium voltage systems.
Proven Knowledge in Power management, load shed systems.  Electrical equipment and electrical system integrity and reliability.
Proven knowledge in: Reviewing specifications and preparing datasheets for various power system components, MCCs,  motors, and uninterruptible power systems (UPS).
Supporting design engineering during the development phase to ensure design meets safety, reliability, and derating performance targets.
 Ability to perform Mean Time Between Failure (MTBF), Failure Modes Effects Analyses (FMEA), Failure Modes Critical Effects Analyses (FMECA), and Fault Trees and performs Fault Tree Analyses (FTA)
 Proven knowledge in: Identifying and analyzing reliability opportunities, design improvements and oversee implementation in coordination with Operations & Maintenance personnel.
Perform Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM) reviews of critical or unreliable equipment. Interprets schematics, references component datasheets, and performs circuit analysis and sensitivity analyses on digital, analog, and power designs.
Preferred exposure to asset performance management tools such as GE Meridium.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in instrumentation or electrical engineering (B.E./B.Tech.)  from a deemed/recognized (AICTE approved) university 
Minimum of 2-10 years relevant experience performing I&E Reliability Engineering in an Oil & Gas operating environment

title: Test Expert
description:
Total Number of Openings

1

Test Expert 

Chevron Corporation is één van de grootste energiebedrijven in de wereld. Wij zijn actief in alle onderdelen van de energie-industrie, van olie- en gaswinning en –productie het raffineren, verkopen en distribueren van brandstoffen, chemicaliën en elektriciteit.  

Chevron Oronite is onderdeel van Chevron en richt zich wereldwijd op het ontwikkelen, produceren en verkopen van additieven voor smeermiddelen en (toekomstige) brandstoffen. In Rotterdam, op onze locatie aan de Vondelingenplaat, bevindt zich één van de vier wereldwijde technologiecentra van Oronite: Chevron Oronite Technology B.V.  

In Rotterdam doen we onderzoek en ontwikkeling op het gebied van smeermiddeladditieven voor auto- en industriële motoren. De locatie beschikt over een motorlaboratorium met auto- en scheepsmotoren, bijbehorende brandstofopslag, een laboratorium en kantoorruimtes.  

Voor ons motorlaboratorium zijn wij op zoek naar een test expert (fulltime). 

Het motorlaboratorium heeft diverse testopstellingen voor testen met personenwagen-, vrachtwagen- en scheepsmotoren. Deze testopstellingen worden beheerd door de test experts. De testen worden uitgevoerd voor het ontwikkelen en testen van additieven voor smeermiddelen en brandstoffen. 

Als test expert werk je in een hecht team van 4. Samen met je collega’s ben je verantwoordelijk voor: 

Beheer & Troubleshooting van testopstellingen:  

Zorgen dat motoropstellingen, emissieapparatuur, besturingssystemen en veiligheidssystemen naar behoren functioneren, zodat testspecificaties en veiligheidseisen gedurende de gehele testperiode worden gehandhaafd. Dit omvat incidenteel ook ondersteuning buiten reguliere werktijden. 

Ontwerp van Test- & Besturingsmethoden:  

In samenwerking met andere teamleden, testprogramma’s en instructies opstellen en beheren, en het ontwerp van besturingsstrategieën ondersteunen om te waarborgen dat het testprogramma de gewenste doelstellingen behaalt. 

Inbedrijfstelling & Projectmanagement van Testopstellingen:  

In samenwerking met interne resources, externe leveranciers, OEM’s, brancheconsortia en/of externe laboratoria ondersteunen bij het opstellen van de scope, het ontwerp en de uitvoering van nieuwbouw en/of de inbedrijfstelling en upgrades van testopstellingen. 

Operational Excellence (OE) en Veilig Werken:  

Leidinggeven aan en ondersteunen van Management of Change (MOC), Isolatie van Gevaarlijke Energie (LOTO), Werkvergunningen, Taak Risico Analyse (JSA), Human and Organizational Performance (HOP). 

Het opstellen van kwalitatief goede procedures en het uitvoeren van procesveiligheids-beoordelingen binnen het Motor Lab. Dit omvat ook het begeleiden en/of trainen van operationeel personeel en mogelijk deelname aan het delen van best practices of Learning Teams met andere laboratoria. 

Externe en Interne Samenwerking:  

Samenwerken met interne en externe partners en laboratoria om de testkwaliteit te verbeteren, uitvaltijd te verminderen en de kostenefficiëntie te verhogen. 

Jouw profiel 

Onze ideale kandidaat brengt de volgende kennis en vaardigheden met zich mee: 

HBO-diploma in een technische richting, bij voorkeur automotive, werktuigbouwkunde, elektrotechniek of mechanical engineering. 

Kennis van en ervaring met de praktische werking van  moderne verbrandingsmotoren, inclusief kritische motorsystemen, functie en ontwerp van motorcomponenten en foutdiagnose, en procesautomatisering. Kennis van motortestopstellingen is een pré. 

Aantoonbare projectmanagement- en uitvoeringsvaardigheden, waaronder zelfstandig kunnen werken, uitstekende projectplanning, organisatorische en multitaskingvaardigheden 

Je bent in staat prioriteiten te stellen.  

Je bent bekend met veiligheidsvoorschriften en het beheersen van risico’s. En je vindt veilig werken net zo belangrijk als wij. 

Je bent in staat anderen te motiveren en aan te moedigen. 

Je bent zelfstandig, maar werkt ook graag nauw samen met anderen. 

Je beschikt over goede kennis van MS Office, met name van Word en Excel. 

Je beheerst de Nederlandse en de Engelse taal in woord en geschrift. 

Je hebt ervaring met projectmanagement. 

Je bent bereid om 1x per 5 weken in een weekenddienst te werken. 

Het is een plus als je daarnaast ook ervaring hebt met: 

het opzetten, gebruiken en troubleshooten van instrumentatie en data-acquisitiesystemen 

foutdetectie, foutafhandeling en automotive diagnostische tools en troubleshooting aan motoren en bijbehorende procesinstallaties 

werken voor of met een motor-OEM of Engine Testing Laboratory (bijvoorbeeld automotive, heavy duty of marine) 

het ontwerpen van besturingsalgoritmen en strategieën voor het interpreteren van voertuigcommunicatieprotocollen. Kennis van basisprincipes van computerprogrammeren 

Ons aanbod 

Wij bieden je een goed arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket en een veelzijdige en uitdagende fulltime functie (40 uur per week) in een internationale werkomgeving. 

Reageren 

Heeft deze functie je interesse gewekt? Reageer dan vandaag nog met een Engelstalig CV. Ook je motivatie waarom je voor deze functie in aanmerking wilt komen, ontvangen wij graag in het Engels.

Meeting the world’s growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all. 

 

About the Position 

 

Chevron ENGINE has an exciting opportunity for a Production Engineer (Shale & Tight) to join the Subsurface team and the role will be based in Chevron’s office in Bengaluru. 

 

Chevron ENGINE supports global operations, and work hours are aligned to business needs. Standard working hours are 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM or 1:30 PM to 10:30 PM, Monday to Friday. These may evolve based on operational or business requirements.  

The Production Engineer (Shale & Tight) is part of the Production Engineering team within the Chevron ENGINE Center and is responsible for ensuring the reliability and efficiency of subsurface operations across Chevron’s Shale and Tight (S&T) assets. The successful candidate will work closely with multidisciplinary teams to optimize production and mitigate risks associated with the extraction of hydrocarbons from shale and tight formations.

Key Responsibilities

Reliability Analysis: Conduct detailed reliability and risk assessments of subsurface equipment and processes, identifying potential failure modes and implementing strategies to mitigate them.

Data Management: Utilize advanced data analytics to monitor performance metrics and trends, providing insights and recommendations for improving asset reliability.

Collaboration: Work collaboratively with geoscientists, reservoir engineers, production engineers, and other stakeholders to develop and implement reliability programs tailored to specific asset needs.

Failure Investigation: Lead root cause analysis of subsurface equipment failures, develop corrective actions, and implement preventive measures to enhance system reliability.

Continuous Improvement: Drive continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance equipment design, maintenance practices, and operational procedures.

Technology Integration: Evaluate and integrate new technologies and methodologies that enhance the reliability and performance of subsurface operations.

Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all subsurface reliability activities comply with industry regulations and company standards.

Reporting: Prepare and present detailed reports and presentations on reliability performance, trends, and improvement initiatives to management and stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Petroleum Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.

Strong understanding of subsurface equipment and technologies used in shale and tight formations.

Preferred Qualifications

5-10 years of experience in reliability engineering, reservoir engineering, or production engineering within the oil and gas industry, with a focus on shale and tight oil and gas assets.

Proficiency in reliability engineering tools and methodologies, such as Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA,) RCA, and reliability modeling software.

Familiarity with industry regulations and best practices related to subsurface operations.

Selection Criteria

Technical Qualifications

Analytical Skills: Proficiency in using statistical and analytical tools to interpret complex data sets and derive actionable insights for reliability improvements.

Software Proficiency: Familiarity with industry-standard software and tools such as MATLAB, Python, or R for data analysis, as well as specialized reliability modeling software like ReliaSoft or RAMS.

Reservoir Simulation: Experience with reservoir simulation software (e.g., Eclipse, CMG, Petrel) to model subsurface behavior and predict production performance.

Geomechanics: Knowledge of geomechanical principles and their application to assess wellbore stability and fracture propagation in shale and tight formations.

Enhanced Oil Recovery Techniques: Understanding of EOR methods applicable to shale and tight reservoirs, such as gas injection or chemical flooding, and their impact on asset reliability.

Production Optimization: Experience in optimizing production systems, including artificial lift technologies (e.g., ESPs, rod pumps) and their reliability considerations.

Asset Integrity Management: Familiarity with asset integrity management practices, including corrosion monitoring and control, to ensure long-term reliability of subsurface equipment.

Well Intervention and Workover Strategies: Knowledge of well intervention and workover techniques to address subsurface reliability issues and enhance production efficiency.

Environmental and Regulatory Compliance: Understanding of environmental regulations and compliance requirements specific to shale and tight oil and gas operations.

Communication

Clarity and Precision: Ability to communicate complex technical information clearly and concisely to diverse audiences, including non-technical stakeholders.

Interpersonal Skills: Strong interpersonal skills to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including geoscientists, reservoir engineers, and other key stakeholders.

Reporting Skills: Proficient in preparing detailed reports and presentations, with the capability to present findings and recommendations persuasively to management and team members.

Leadership Behaviors

Influence and Inspire: Ability to lead and motivate teams towards achieving reliability goals, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.

Decision Making: Demonstrated capability to make informed decisions under pressure, balancing technical requirements with operational constraints.

Ethical Standards: Commitment to maintaining high ethical standards and ensuring compliance with industry regulations and company policies.

Deliver Results

Problem Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a proven track record of identifying issues, developing solutions, and implementing effective action plans.

Project Management: Experience in leading projects from conception to completion, ensuring timely delivery of results that meet or exceed expectations.

Performance Monitoring: Skilled in using data analytics to monitor performance metrics, identify trends, and drive improvements in asset reliability and operational efficiency.

Have the opportunity to take part in world-leading energy projects, advance your professional development and expand your career within an inclusive and collaborative workplace. 

Join a workplace where innovation, collaboration and safety are at the core of how we work.

title: Senior Instrumentation Engineer (Portugues)
description:
Construyendo sobre nuestro pasado. Listos para el futuro
Worley es una firma global de servicios profesionales compuesta por expertos en energía, productos químicos y recursos. Nos asociamos con clientes para entregar proyectos y crear valor durante la vida útil de sus activos. Estamos uniendo dos mundos, avanzando hacia fuentes de energía más sostenibles y al mismo tiempo ayudamos a proporcionar la energía, los productos químicos y los recursos que se necesitan ahora.
Objetivo del cargo:
Responsabilizarse por la realización y asignación de trabajos de ingeniería complejos o con alto nivel de dificultad, debido a su capacidad, conocimiento avanzado, especialización y experiencia en el dominio de una o múltiples áreas de la ingeniería y de su disciplina en particular, además de otro tipo de productos y sistemas.
Con habilidad y capacidad de liderazgo para dirigir pequeños grupos en proyectos o equipos de trabajo.
.
Principales Responsabilidades:
Tomar decisiones responsables para la definición del curso de entregables de ingeniería, dibujo y modelamiento.
Las decisiones difíciles, complejas o inusuales se remitirán al Gerente de Ingeniería o al Gerente de la disciplina locales.
Trabajar de forma autónoma permitiendo la planificación y organización de tareas en proyectos asignados, propias y de los integrantes de su equipo, en caso de dirigir uno.
Realizar sus funciones con base en una interacción y orientación técnica autoiniciada con el supervisor (gerente de la disciplina), para posteriormente influenciar sobre los objetivos y deberes de su equipo.
Recibir, gestionar y llevar a cabo asignaciones relacionadas con proyectos de ingeniería con objetivos y prioridades específicas, considerando las áreas críticas que pueden afectar el trabajo de otras unidades. Puede ser supervisor de actividades o también tener supervisión para determinación de
precisión, integridad y cumplimiento de los objetivos.
Trabajar en equipos de hasta 10 personas que le reportan directamente, ya sea participando o liderando, y que pueden estar conformados por ingenieros y diseñadores de la misma disciplina, pero podrían incluir un tamaño total mucho mayor que considere un apoyo coordinado. Puede tener autoridad para las evaluaciones de desempeño que afectan el salario de otros profesionales.
Mantener una comunicación constante y efectiva con el equipo de trabajo, para informar y persuadir sobre asuntos complejos y problemas a través de la preparación y entrega de propuestas, presentaciones e informes, así como la colaboración con las partes interesadas y la gerencia de la disciplina.
Trabajar de manera competente y eficiente en herramientas de diseño especializado, análisis y modelado, y métodos centrados en datos interdisciplinarios.
Construir relaciones apropiadas, constructivas y efectivas en toda la organización; usar la diplomacia y el tacto, ser accesible, comunicarse con claridad, precisión y coherencia tanto verbalmente como por escrito. Emplear los principios de la escucha activa y fomentar la retroalimentación desde y hacia los demás.
Trabajar en un equipo con visibilidad para las partes interesadas en altos niveles, ser capaz de trabajar y vincularse con múltiples equipos y partes interesadas, ser capaz de priorizar las cargas de trabajo y ayudar a otros miembros del equipo a lograr sus objetivos.
Lograr los resultados establecidos por sí mismo y por otros, cumpliendo con los plazos establecido definidos.
Esforzarse por lograr objetivos ambiciosos, demostrando entusiasmo, persistencia y tenacidad.
Dividir y priorizar el trabajo en tareas ejecutables.
Responzabilizarse por el trabajo producido y asegurase de que sea "correcto desde la primera vez".
Adaptarse al aprendizaje e implementación de nuevos conceptos con mayor complejidad.
Examinar los problemas cuidadosa y minuciosamente y comprender sus interdependencias para proponer soluciones
¿Qué traerás?
Software, procesos y herramientas:
Por lo general, tener más de 10 años de experiencia relevante en la disciplina y un conocimiento y comprensión competente de las regulaciones, códigos, estándares de diseño y fabricación, y prácticas estándar de la industria.
Adicionalmente debe tener conocimientos sólidos en la estimación de los costos de un proyecto y la redacción de contenidos de propuestas.
Tener experiencia en la realización de ingenierías conceptuales, básicas y detalladas de proyectos de la industria (Oil & Gas, Minería, Infraestructura, entre otros).
NIvel de Inglés: B1
Nivel de Portugues: B2-C1
Lugar: Bogotá (teletrabajo hibrido)
Ser competente en el uso de herramientas como Microsoft 365 y Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, Power Point y Teams). Puede navegar por las páginas de la intranet, realizar búsquedas y recuperar información. Puede organizar información de múltiples fuentes y retenerla según el formato y las políticas establecidas.
En caso de que necesites algún
ajuste de accesibilidad
por favor no dejes de aclararlo en tu postulación.
Avanzando juntos
Estamos comprometidos a construir un lugar de trabajo diverso, inclusivo y respetuoso donde todos sientan que pertenecen, puedan hablar y ser escuchados. Brindamos igualdad de oportunidades de empleo a todos los solicitantes y empleados calificados sin importar edad, raza, credo, color, religión, sexo, origen nacional, ascendencia, estado de discapacidad, estado de veterano, orientación sexual, identidad o expresión de género, información genética, estado civil. estatus, estatus de ciudadanía o cualquier otra base protegida por la ley.
Queremos que nuestra gente esté llena de energía y poder para impulsar un impacto sostenible. Por eso, nos centramos en una cultura inspirada en valores que genere brillantez a través de la pertenencia, la conexión y la innovación.
Estamos construyendo un lugar de trabajo diverso, inclusivo y respetuoso. Crear un espacio donde todos sientan que pertenecen, puedan ser ellos mismos y ser escuchados.
Y no estamos hablando sólo de eso; lo estamos haciendo. Estamos recapacitando a nuestra gente, aprovechando habilidades transferibles y apoyando la transición de nuestra fuerza laboral para convertirse en expertos en la infraestructura y tecnología de energía baja en carbono de hoy.
Cualquiera que sea tu ambición, aquí hay un camino para ti. Y no existe ninguna barrera para el posible éxito profesional. Únase a nosotros para ampliar sus horizontes, explorar diversas oportunidades y ser parte del logro de un cambio sostenible.

title: Customer Engagement Partner - Digital Consulting
description:
Customer Engagement Partner
Worley Consulting Group
Americas
Worley Consulting. Be part of the solution.
Worley Consulting is a global group of consultants, scientists, engineers, and digital experts dedicated to solving the world’s critical infrastructure, environmental, energy, and resource challenges.
We partner with our customers to find solutions that create value over the life of their assets. We implement new technologies to run assets more efficiently, secure and safeguard social license, support local communities, and accelerate the energy transition.
We evaluate options and identify opportunities and risks to support our customers’ decision making. We assist with asset strategy and selection, business case preparation, concept and feasibility studies, technology evaluation, energy strategies and asset operational excellence.
Purpose:
The Customer Engagement Partner occupies a pivotal role at the intersection of
technical excellence, strategic delivery, and customer-centric leadership. This
position is responsible for spearheading growth by identifying and connecting
internal capabilities to solve customers’ most complex technical challenges and
sponsoring project delivery excellence. With a deep understanding of both the
Consulting landscape and Worley’s extensive expertise, the Customer
Engagement Partner forges new relationships, sustains existing partnerships,
and shapes strategic growth for enduring impact.
This is a full-time hybrid position based at a Worley office in the United States: Houston, Texas. Other locations across the US and Canada will be considered.
Overall Responsibilities and Key Accountabilities
Customer Engagement & Practice Growth
Practice Leadership: Leads the growth for the assigned customer portfolio and sector focus, in alignment with the global practice strategy.
Brand Advocacy: Champions Worley’s brand in the marketplace, leveraging internal capabilities to win new business and reinforce the company’s reputation.
P&L Expansion: Accountable for revenue and GM growth within the assigned customer portfolio; P&L ownership sits with [BU / Regional lead]
Technical Expertise & Capability Alignment
Capability Identification: Proactively identifies, accesses, and mobilizes the breadth of technical expertise within Worley to resolve multifaceted customer challenges.
Relationship Building: Builds strong, collaborative relationships across all levels and disciplines within Worley, acting as a connector between disparate teams and fostering a culture of shared knowledge and mutual support.
Capability Mapping: Develops a deep understanding of Worley’s technical capabilities and able to navigate and translate these capabilities into customer solutions, whilst staying abreast of emerging technologies, trends, and methodologies.
Delivery Leadership
Project Oversight: Oversees the delivery of projects as executive sponsor responsible for stakeholder alignment, collaborating with operational leadership and technical experts to leverage the skills of multidisciplinary teams, and ensure quality outcomes within time and budget constraints.
Strategic Collaboration: Partners with other Consulting leaders to address major business issues, ensuring a unified approach to problem-solving
and customer engagement.
Workforce Planning: Recognizes market trends and capability requirements, collaborating with P&L leadership to proactively plan workforce needs and skill development initiatives.
Strategic Input & Business Development
Proposal Leadership: Leads the communication and presentation of complex technical proposals, ensuring clarity, persuasion, and strategic alignment with customer objectives.
Growth Strategy Design: Co-develops growth strategies with the P&L leader and leads the execution in the assigned customer portfolio.
Knowledge Sharing: Shares actionable customer insights with fellow Consulting leaders, contributing to the development and refinement of core account strategies and solutions.
What you will bring
Technical and Industry Experience
10+ years of experience in consulting, engineering, or technical project delivery, with a significant portion in customer-facing or business development roles.
Proven record of successfully winning new business and expanding customer relationships in a competitive market.
Demonstrated success in leading multidisciplinary teams and delivering complex projects on time and within budget.
Strong commercial understanding, with prior experience in delivery of consulting projects, practice growth, and strategic account leadership.
Exposure to workforce planning and capability development within a consulting or technical environment.
Willing to travel ~40-50% as required.
Competencies & Attributes
Relationship Management: Exceptional interpersonal skills, with a proven track record of building trust and forging partnerships both internally and externally.
Technical Acumen: Deep expertise in engineering, consulting, or a related technical field, with the ability to assess complex problems and identify innovative solutions.
Strategic Thinking: Ability to see the “big picture,” anticipate market shifts, and design strategies to maintain a competitive edge.
Leadership: Strong leadership presence and the ability to inspire and motivate cross-functional teams towards common objectives.
Delivery: Prior experience in successful delivery of consulting projects.
Commercial Savvy: A results-oriented mindset with experience in growing practice areas and driving profitability.
Communication: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, including experience presenting to senior customer executives and crafting compelling proposals.
Adaptability: Ability to thrive in a dynamic environment, managing multiple priorities and navigating ambiguity with resilience and creativity
.
Education – Qualifications, Accreditation, Training
Required:
Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, or a related field; Master’s degree or MBA preferred.
Worley Consulting offers an excellent remuneration & benefits package, a friendly, professional, dynamic and flexible work environment along with the opportunity to develop your career prospects locally and internationally.
We strive to be an industry leader in health, safety and environmental performance. Our vision is to achieve zero harm to people and assets, and zero environmental incidents. :

title: Especialista Senior en Redes Industriales - IT/OT, Ciberseguridad y Comunicaciones (Oil&Gas / Minería)
description:
Building on our past. Ready for the future
Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts. We partner with customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their assets. We’re bridging two worlds, moving towards more sustainable energy sources, while helping to provide the energy, chemicals and resources needed now.
Especialista Sénior en Redes
Objetivo:
El objetivo principal del Especialista Sénior en Redes será actuar como Experto en la Materia para el diseño e implementación de redes de datos seguras, fiables y de alto rendimiento para entornos industriales en los sectores de Petróleo y Gas, Minería, Energía y Química. Este puesto proporciona experiencia técnica en redes de TI y OT, redes de acceso inalámbrico (incluyendo pLTE/5G), ciberseguridad industrial e integración de sistemas operativos con la infraestructura empresarial.
El candidato seleccionado asesorará a nuestros clientes y guiará/liderará el diseño de la red en todas las fases del proyecto, desde el diseño conceptual de alto nivel hasta la implementación. El puesto se centra en facilitar soluciones seguras, resilientes y escalables para impulsar la automatización, la digitalización, el IIoT y las operaciones autónomas.
Este puesto es híbrido y a tiempo completo, con sede en la oficina de Worley en Colombia.
Responsabilidades generales y responsabilidades clave
Pre-FEED / FEED y diseño detallado:
· Desarrollar paquetes de diseño de alto y bajo nivel para redes industriales
· Definir estrategias de segmentación de red en consonancia con las mejores prácticas de ciberseguridad
· Elaborar criterios de diseño y filosofías de red.
· Diseñar redes privadas LTE/5G, Wi-Fi y otras redes de datos inalámbricas para aplicaciones industriales
· Dar soporte a IioT, computación de borde y análisis de arquitecturas de adquisición de datos, gemelos digitales y sistemas de automatización.
· Definir los requisitos de ancho de banda, los modelos de redundancia y los objetivos de disponibilidad.
· Desarrollar el inventario de activos de red y realizar evaluaciones de ciberseguridad.
· Desarrollar informes FEED, especificaciones de equipos de red y MTO.
· Elaborar diagramas de topología de red, arquitecturas de sistema, esquemas de direccionamiento IP, planes de VLAN y conjuntos de reglas de firewall.
· Aportar información para el diseño de redes de fibra óptica, la disposición de armarios y los diagramas de terminación.
· Participar en evaluaciones de riesgos.
Coordinación Multidisciplinaria y Soporte de Adquisiciones:
· Interactuar con diversos equipos de proyecto, tanto internos como externos (Automatización, Electricidad, TI, Operaciones, Ciberseguridad, etc.), para coordinar los requisitos e interfaces de la red.
· Preparar especificaciones técnicas, hojas de datos y solicitudes de materiales para equipos de red.
· Preparar procedimientos FAT y SAT.
· Participar en FAT, SAT y otros tipos de inspecciones para sistemas de red y ciberseguridad.

· Apoyar la configuración de la red, la validación y las pruebas de integración de sistemas.

Ciberseguridad y Resiliencia de la Red:
· Diseñar e implementar controles de ciberseguridad industrial que cumplan con las normas IEC 62443, NIST y las mejores prácticas del sector.
· Definir arquitecturas de firewall, políticas de control de acceso, soluciones de acceso remoto y requisitos de monitorización.
· Apoyar las evaluaciones de riesgos y las revisiones del diseño de ciberseguridad. · Apoyar la integración segura de sistemas OT con entornos de TI empresariales y plataformas en la nube.
Experiencia Técnica e Industrial:
Experiencia en la implementación de soluciones de redes industriales en los sectores de petróleo y gas, minería, energía, química o entornos industriales similares.
Sólido conocimiento de la convergencia de TI/OT y de las arquitecturas de redes industriales.
Experiencia en el diseño e implementación de redes Wi-Fi, LTE/5G privadas para instalaciones industriales.
Experiencia práctica en el diseño de redes para edificios e instalaciones industriales, incluyendo centros de datos, plantas internas y externas (OSP).
Experiencia en la implementación de planes de ciberseguridad en instalaciones industriales.
Experiencia en diversas redes industriales, incluyendo Ethernet, Ethernet IP, Profibus, etc.
Experiencia en IIoT, edge computing y plataformas de integración de datos.
Experiencia con marcos y estándares de ciberseguridad industrial (IEC 62443, NIST, ISO 27001).
Familiarización con entornos de ejecución de proyectos EPC/EPCM.
Experiencia en el apoyo a las fases de ingeniería conceptual, FEED y de detalle.
Experiencia en la selección de proveedores, integración de sistemas y actividades de pruebas (FAT/SAT).
Experiencia práctica en la instalación, configuración y puesta en marcha de sistemas de red.
Fluidez en inglés (lectura, escritura y habla).
Educación – Cualificaciones, Acreditación, Formación:
· Licenciatura o Máster reconocido en Informática, Telecomunicaciones, Electrónica o un campo afín, otorgado por una universidad acreditada.
· Se valorarán certificaciones en ciberseguridad como ISA/IEC 62443, ISC2 CC u otras.

Posee un amplio conocimiento de las regulaciones, códigos, normas de fabricación y prácticas estándar de la industria pertinentes para el control, desarrollo y aplicación de entregables de la disciplina procesos.
Desarrolla Ingeniería de Valor de acuerdo con los criterios del DM y Principal, dependiendo del alcance del proyecto y necesidades del cliente.
Corresponsable de la calidad de los entregables de la disciplina procesos, del cumplimiento de los alcances, de garantizar un diseño sustentable y sostenible
Tiene el conocimiento para estimar el esfuerzo requerido por un equipo de su disciplina para realizar los alcances del proyecto, controla las WH asignadas y administrarlas
Colabora con el DM y/o principal en propuestas técnico/comerciales comprendiendo el alcance y pudiendo estimar el esfuerzo necesario para cumplir con el desarrollo de un servicio determinado solicitado por el cliente.
Conocimiento de software de procesos
Tiene experiencia en diferentes etapas de estudios de ingeniería (Perfil, Conceptual, Prefactilbidad, Factibilidad, Detalle), Deseable conocimiento en Precomisionamiento, Comisionamiento y Operación.
Cumple plazos eficientes y realistas para la producción de Estudios
Respecto al Alcance del Trabajo (Scope of Work – SoW) es corresponsable de la ejecución del criterio de diseño, filosofía de operación, presupuesto y cronograma, con los entregables a presentar, asegurando la correcta generación (no taxativa) de P&IDs, PFDs, Estrategias de Control de Procesos, Planes de Comisionamiento y Operación, y el resto de documentación acordada con el cliente
Coordinación con el resto de las disciplinas, clientes, vendors y contratistas de manera profesional y colaborativa, buscando el éxito del proyecto.
Corresponsable del cumplimiento de los lineamientos del Sistema de Aseguramiento de Calidad de Worley y el Sistema HSE en la producción de ingeniería asignada.
Preparación y revisión de informes técnicos: criterios de diseño, filosofía operativa, diagramación y esquemas generales, dimensionamiento de equipos mineros, informes técnicos, estimaciones de costos de inversión y operación.
¿Qué traerás?
Experiencia Específica:
Mínimo 12 años de experiencia profesional relevante, y al menos 3 años desempeñándose en un rol similar.
Posee una sólida formación en procesos metalúrgicos y químicos y un profundo conocimiento de las regulaciones, códigos, estándares de fabricación y prácticas estándar de la industria minera.
Haber participado en proyectos de minería subterránea.

:
Se requiere un título de Ingeniero de Metalurgista o Ingeniero Químico o Químico, con registro activo en el Colegio de Ingenieros del Perú (#CIP).
Deseable, Maestría en Gerencia de Proyectos o algún campo relacionado.
Capacitación en liderazgo y ejecución de proyectos. Estará autorizado por un organismo regulador local de ingeniería cuando lo exija la ley.
Idiomas:
Nivel de Inglés Intermedio avanzado (+).
Conocimientos Específicos:
Ingeniería de Procesos, en procesamiento de minerales, con foco en metales base.
Experiencia en procesamiento de otro tipo de metales es valorada.
Experiencia y conocimiento en las diferentes etapas de los estudios de ingeniería (Prefactibilidad, Factibilidad y Detalles).
Experiencia en preparación de estimación de capex y opex mina.

Liderazgo de la disciplina procesos y trabajo en equipo en proyectos de ingeniería multidisciplinarios.
Compromiso con HSE:
Promueve de forma activa los comportamientos de nuestro valor LIFE y Políticas HSE aplicables a la Disciplina.
Asumir la gestión práctica y la implementación de todos los requisitos relevantes de HSE de la empresa.
Impulsar resultados de ingeniería seguros y sostenibles a lo largo del ciclo de vida de los activos mediante la aplicación de SEAL.

.

Trabajo híbrido

title: Dry Area Manager
description:
Building on our past. Ready for the future
Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts. We partner with customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their assets. We’re bridging two worlds, moving towards more sustainable energy sources, while helping to provide the energy, chemicals and resources needed now.
Objective:
Provides direction and project management to ensure project completion in accordance with contractual obligations for a section of a total project with package value in the range of USD100-500 million. Defines project goals and devises methods to accomplish them; develops in-depth knowledge of customer objectives, contract terms, and corporate policies.  Plans, organizes, manages, and controls projects with the established policies, procedures, systems, and requirements approved by the Worley. Supervises project personnel through subordinate leaders. Project managers will exhibit leadership skills necessary to achieve project goals.
Responsibilities:
Typically manages specialized, complex (high-impact) parts of a single projects or multiple, but similar type projects.  This includes small and medium projects or a portion of a large or mega project.   Develops and oversees project plans, including business, production, and/or organizational priorities.  Produces integrated solutions to strategic issues and presents recommendations to customers. Solutions are derived from knowledge gained through past experiences and consultation with internal and external resources.  May serve as a proposal manager for small to medium projects.
Project Size Category: Medium, Large
Typical Project Risk Classification: Moderate, High (excl SR1, SR2, SR3, SR4, SR5, SR6, SR7, SR8, SR9, SR16, SR19, SR21)
Health & Safety
• Understands and embraces Life.
• Demonstrates full commitment to all health and safety matters and provides safety leadership to project team.
• Satisfies all requirements of project safety compliance including Safety by Design, Constructability and Maintainability.
• Has led or participated in Constructability, Operability and Maintainability Workshops.
Leadership
• Defines and selects team required to deliver scope of work.
• Effectively leads project team comprised of multi‐discipline/ multi‐location members.
• Sets clear objectives for the project team including scope, schedule, productivity and budget targets.
• Oversees, motivates and monitors the performance of the team, ensuring quality and timeliness of assignments and roles, and addresses any performance gaps.
• Implements communication tools and process to ensure all team members are informed about project status and key performance indicators.
• Demonstrates the ability to build support for ideas, presenting alternatives and recommendations persuasively.
Technical Expertise
• Experience in the delivery of large scale mining projects
•    Experience in the design and delivery of copper concentrator plants
Ensures Worley methodologies, processes, tools and systems are used throughout the project and compliance requirements are met/satisfied.
• Applies knowledge of all aspects of a project (engineering, procurement, quality control, etc.) to oversee the successful execution of the project plan.
• Ensures design team is aware and complying with customer Basis of Design and applicable codes and regulations.
• Demonstrates attention to detail.
• Demonstrated understanding of engineering project delivery workflow and coordination.
• Experience with procurement/subcontracting and on-site construction support.
• Has completed a full project from start to finish and spent time supporting the field to implement what was engineered.
Financial Acumen
• Applies in‐depth knowledge of customer contract to the oversight and management of the project.
• Strong understanding and application of business drivers, financial reporting standards.
• Tracks cost and schedule and uses analytical skill to forecast trends.
• Project deliverables and design quantities are tracked and analysed.
• Understands project cost buildup including gross margin together with risks that may erode margin and opportunities to improve margin.
• Ensures proper change control processes are understood and used by the project team.
• Manages cash flow requirements, including accounts receivable, and work in progress to minimize days sales outstanding (DSO).
Execution Planning & Performance
• Experienced in developing/reviewing Project Execution Plan covering all aspects of the scope.
• Applies lessons learned as inputs to planning the project execution.
• Manages execution, coordination, and implements regular reviews/controls to track project progress.
• Good understanding of Project Control Reports, identifies problem areas and implements recovery plans.
• Interprets and understands key elements of the project schedule and resource plan.
• Incorporates Value Creation and Sustainable Solutions objectives into project plan, measures and delivers to objectives.
• Experienced in successful workshare execution.
Communication & Networking
• Effectively communicate and take a leadership role in preparing and presenting proposals and reports to staff and management.
• Implements clear communication protocols, processes and tools for the project team.
• Clearly communicates project requirements, contractual requirements, customer expectation, KPI and project status with project team.
• Creates an environment for open communication and builds high performing team on trust and respect.
• Resolves issues and conflicts within the project team including customer.
• Effectively relates with people across levels, functions, geography and cultures.
• Works collaboratively with others across the organization to achieve shared objectives.
Customer & Stakeholder Management
• Identifies and understands the customer’s key drivers (KPIs).
• Manages customer representatives and other significant stakeholders.
• Manages and nurtures customer and stakeholder relationship based on established expectations and communication protocols.
• Develops a relationship of trust and respect with ability to discuss project progress, challenges and issues in a transparent manner.
Risk & Opportunity Management
• Understands commercial and legal risks in the contract, prepares and manages mitigation plans.
• Identifies potential risks or new risks as the project progresses and effectively develops risk mitigation, contingency and resolution plans.
• Follows Worley risk management procedures.
• Keeps detailed risk register that stays current and is tracked & communicated on a regular basis (at least monthly).
• Utilizes Risk Register items as the basis for any project contingency budget.
Requirements:
University Degree, or equivalent, in related field or applicable discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
-    Typically 15+ years experience, including 12+ years of relevant supervisory, project management and/or technical experience; Workshare experience; E, EP Project experience.
-    Experience as Dry Area Manager in the construction or concentrator plants.
Job Specific Knowledge / Experience (Desirable):
Demonstrated PM experience leading medium and large projects with medium and high risk elements; EPCM, EPC including site assignments; Multi-Cultural / Multi-National environments.
Systems & Tools (Essential)
Advanced understanding of systems, processes and tools related to field.  Able to assist others and troubleshoot issues. Competent in Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, Teams and PowerPoint.  Can organize information from many sources and retain as per the prescribed format and policies.
Systems & Tools (Desirable)
May be involved in the development of new systems, processes and tools; Competent in Microsoft Access and Visio.
Supervision Authority
Reporting to the overall Project Director as part of the senior leadership team, works collaboratively across the project but assigns project work and gives technical guidance to people assigned to work on medium to large sized projects.  Reviews work for technical accuracy and adequacy.  May have direct and indirect reports and authority for performance evaluations impacting pay. May make recommendations concerning selection, training, rating and discipline of people.
If you need any
accessibility adjustments
, please make sure to mention it in your application.
Moving forward together
We’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels they belong, can bring themselves, and are heard. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by law.
We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation.
And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology.
Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

description:

Ingeniero Senior de Telecomunicaciones – Cableado Estructurado / Redes Industriales (Oil & Gas / Minería / Energía)
Estamos reforzando nuestro equipo en Worley y tenemos una oportunidad para un profesional con experiencia en diseño e ingeniería de sistemas de cableado estructurado, fibra óptica, redes industriales, salas técnicas, rutas y bandejas, y soporte en fases FEED / Detalle / Construcción / Comisionamiento para proyectos en:  Oil & Gas, Minería,
Energía / Power, Infraestructura Industrial y Química
Si tienes este perfil o conoces a alguien que pueda estar interesado, comparte este mensaje e invítalo a aplicar.
El objetivo principal del puesto de Ingeniero Principal de Telecomunicaciones Senior especializado en Sistemas de Cableado Estructurado será actuar como autoridad técnica en el diseño y la entrega de infraestructura de cableado estructurado para proyectos industriales en los sectores de petróleo y gas, minería, energía y química. Este puesto proporciona liderazgo técnico durante todas las fases de diseño y apoya las actividades de construcción y puesta en marcha. El candidato seleccionado liderará la arquitectura y la ingeniería general de redes de fibra óptica, el diseño de cableado horizontal y la infraestructura relacionada, garantizando diseños seguros, fiables y escalables, alineados con las necesidades del cliente y del proyecto.
Responsabilidades
Definir la arquitectura/topologías de alto nivel, los diagramas de bloques y los requisitos de infraestructura física.
Desarrollar las bases de diseño, las filosofías del proyecto y las hojas de ruta tecnológicas.
Estimar las cantidades de cableado e infraestructura de soporte, los requisitos de espacio y energía, y elaborar los informes correspondientes.
Elaborar los entregables de ingeniería, incluyendo los criterios y especificaciones de diseño, los planos de enrutamiento de cables a nivel de FEED, los diseños de los gabinetes, los diseños de las salas de equipos y la lista de carga.
Elaborar la lista de materiales, los despegues de materiales y la aportación técnica para las estimaciones de costos de TIC.
Identificar y coordinar los requisitos de conectividad con las redes de automatización, eléctricas, de TI y otras redes.
Elaborar informes FEED.
Liderar el desarrollo de paquetes de planos IFC, incluyendo los diseños de enrutamiento de cables, los diagramas de empalme y terminación, los diagramas de cableado, los detalles de los gabinetes, los planos de planta, los detalles de instalación, los EWP, los CWP, el alcance del trabajo del proveedor y las requisiciones de materiales, etc.
Revisar la documentación del proveedor y coordinar el desarrollo de los paquetes del proveedor.
Garantizar la constructibilidad, el mantenimiento y la operatividad de todos los entregables.
Experiencia Técnica e Industrial:
* Experiencia en operaciones industriales: Minería, Petróleo y Gas, Energía y Química.
* Experto en diseño e implementación de sistemas de cableado estructurado.
* Experiencia en redes OT, redes industriales e integración con sistemas de automatización.
* Familiarizado con entornos de ejecución de proyectos EPC/EPCM.
* Experto en diseño de sistemas de control de acceso, CCTV, telefonía VoIP, LTE/5G privado, radio bidireccional, sistemas de megafonía y alarma general (PAGA), sistemas Wi-Fi en redes IP y otros servicios de telecomunicaciones.
* Conocimiento de las normas UIT-T, UIT-R, TIA, IEEE, ISO/IEC, NFPA y CSA.
* Experiencia en ingeniería conceptual, básica y de detalle, e implementación de arquitecturas de redes de fibra óptica de alta disponibilidad en entornos industriales.
* Experiencia práctica en el despliegue y/o la operación de sistemas de telecomunicaciones.
* Experiencia práctica en la puesta en marcha de sistemas de telecomunicaciones.
* Experiencia con diversos sistemas de telecomunicaciones y productos de red. Experiencia en diversas fases de selección de proveedores y tecnología.
* Experiencia en inspección y pruebas de equipos (FAT, SAT y recorridos de sistema).
* Experiencia en requisitos de instalación de equipos.
* Dominio del inglés (lectura, escritura y habla).
Educación – Cualificaciones, Acreditación, Formación:
Licenciatura o Máster reconocido en Telecomunicaciones, Electricidad, Electrónica, Informática o un campo afín, otorgado por una universidad acreditada.
Se valorará la certificación RCDD de BICSI.
Se valorará la certificación PMP u otras formas de acreditar formación en gestión de proyectos.

title: Ingeniero Senior de Telecomunicaciones - offshore y marinos
description:
Building on our past. Ready for the future
Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts. We partner with customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their assets. We’re bridging two worlds, moving towards more sustainable energy sources, while helping to provide the energy, chemicals and resources needed now.
Ingeniero Senior de Telecomunicaciones - sistemas de telecomunicaciones offshore y marinos
¿Tienes experiencia en sistemas de telecomunicaciones offshore y marinos (GMDSS, VSAT, ship-to-shore, PAGA, CCTV, VoIP, etc.) y has trabajado en proyectos de Oil & Gas o entornos industriales? Entonces este puesto es para ti.
El objetivo principal del puesto de Ingeniero Principal de Telecomunicaciones Senior especializado en Sistemas de Comunicación Offshore será actuar como Experto en la Materia para sistemas de comunicación offshore y marinos que brinden soporte a complejas instalaciones de producción de petróleo y gas, plataformas de perforación, FPSO y entornos marinos. Este puesto proporciona liderazgo técnico durante todas las fases de diseño y apoya las actividades de construcción y puesta en servicio. El candidato seleccionado liderará la ingeniería de sistemas críticos de comunicación, navegación y seguridad, incluyendo, entre otros, radio bidireccional, comunicaciones satelitales, WIMAX, enlaces barco-costa, GMDSS, sistema meteorológico, sistema de comunicación de botes salvavidas, sistema giroscópico, etc., garantizando operaciones seguras, conformes y confiables en entornos offshore.
Responsabilidades:
Diseño Pre-FEED/FEED y Detallado:
* Definir la arquitectura/topologías de alto nivel, los diagramas de bloques y los requisitos de infraestructura física.
* Desarrollar las bases de diseño, las filosofías del proyecto y las hojas de ruta tecnológicas.
* Estimar las cantidades de infraestructura de telecomunicaciones, los requisitos de espacio y energía, y elaborar los informes correspondientes.
* Producir los entregables de ingeniería, incluyendo los criterios y especificaciones de diseño, los planos de ubicación y enrutamiento de cables a nivel FEED, los planos de gabinetes, los planos de salas de equipos, los estudios de cobertura y la lista de carga.
* Desarrollar la lista de materiales, los despegues de materiales y la aportación técnica para las estimaciones de costos de TIC.
* Participar en las evaluaciones de riesgos.

title: SME - Tin
description:

Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia.
Right now, we’re bridging two worlds as we accelerate to more sustainable energy sources, while helping our customers provide the energy, chemicals and resources that society needs now.

P
urpose
This role is suited to a senior professional with a strong process engineering background and demonstrated experience leading front-end studies for mining and mineral processing projects.
The Study Manager will lead multi-discipline studies from concept through Pre-Feasibility and Feasibility levels, ensuring that technical work is fully integrated with cost, schedule, risk, and permitting considerations. The role requires a strong client focus and the ability to manage studies as investment decision tools, not just technical deliverables.
R
esponsibilities
Study Leadership & Delivery
•    Lead and manage mineral processing and mining-related studies from Scoping through PFS/FS, ensuring safety, quality, schedule, and cost objectives are met.
•    Act as the single point of accountability for study execution, scope control, and integration across disciplines.
•    Establish study strategies, manage critical path schedules, and ensure timely delivery of decision-ready outputs.
•    Lead regular reviews of study progress, budgets, resources, and risks, addressing issues proactively.
Technical Integration & Process Oversight
•    Provide senior oversight of process engineering and metallurgical inputs, ensuring assumptions are realistic, consistent, and fit for study maturity.
•    Integrate process design with mining, infrastructure, tailings, water, environmental, and permitting inputs.
•    Coordinate internal subject matter experts and external specialists or technology providers, as required.
•    Ensure that study outcomes are technically robust and aligned with industry best practices.
Business Case & Economics
•    Lead the integration of technical outputs into CAPEX, OPEX, and economic models.
•    Support evaluation of alternative development options and trade-offs to maximize project value.
•    Ensure that studies clearly articulate value drivers, risks, and sensitivities to support informed investment decisions.
Client & Stakeholder Engagement
•    Maintain a strong client focus, understanding client objectives and ensuring study outcomes meet expectations.
•    Lead technical workshops, option selection sessions, and study reviews with clients and internal leadership.
•    Support business development activities in a seller–doer capacity, including proposal preparation and client engagement.
Governance, Risk & Assurance
•    Ensure that study risks, assumptions, and uncertainties are clearly identified and communicated.
•    Comply with internal quality, health, safety, and environmental management systems.
•    Support internal and external reviews, audits, and assurance processes.
What you will bring
R
equirements:
•
Degree in Metallurgical Engineering, Mineral Processing, Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline.
•    15–25+ years of experience in minerals processing and mining projects, with a strong background in process engineering.
•    Demonstrated experience leading Scoping, PFS, and FS studies within an engineering consulting or owner environment.
•    Proven ability to manage complex, multi-discipline studies and deliver decision-focused outcomes.
•    Strong understanding of mineral processing circuits; experience with gravity-dominated or specialty minerals is an advantage.
•    Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
•    High level of proficiency in report writing, presentations, and study documentation.
•    Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.
Desirable Attributes
•    Experience in tin processing plants.
•    Experience working with external technology providers or licensors.
•    Bilingual Spanish / English.

description:

HSE Manager - UK
Role Context:
The Senior HSE Manager for the UK provides support to the Location Lead SVP, Project and Construction Management, and HSE Teams. They will work closely with teams across the UK to coach, influence, and help implement effective HSE programmes that drive safe behaviors and ensure compliance through governance checks aligned with management and project system requirements.
The HSE Manager UK will have responsibility for HSE deliverables in supporting bids, FEEDs, and associated tenders, and will be required to interface with both internal and external stakeholders. This role is primarily home‑office based/hybrid based but will require a degree of travel for site engagement and other office locations across the UK.
A key aspect of the HSE Manager UK role is providing direct, hands‑on support to projects across the UK Operation. Beyond strategic oversight, this position will actively engage with project teams in the field—working closely with Project Managers, Site Leaders, and HSE personnel to ensure that HSE requirements are fully understood, embedded, and effectively executed.
In this role is the HSE Manager UK will be part of the UK extended leadership team acting as HSE operational business partner to the UK Operational Lead SVP. This role involves providing proactive HSE guidance, ensuring that operational decisions reflect best practice, legislative requirements, and company standards, while also helping to drive a culture of safety leadership across all levels of the organization. The HSE Manager UK will work closely with the UK leadership team offering practical recommendations relating to internal standards, industry best practice and UK Regulation / Legislation.

They will provide Project Managers, Construction Managers, Project Management Teams, and their teams with the necessary information, guidance, and associated services related to Health, Safety, and Environmental activities.
The Senior HSE Manager will manage both HSE and Training and Competence Teams.
The HSE Manager UK will maintain a hands‑on approach to support business demands and will actively drive operational alignment and HSE excellence across the UK, ensuring Health, Safety, and Environment priorities are embedded in every aspect of project delivery.
The role plays a critical part in fostering a culture of safety leadership and accountability. This position reports directly to the Regional HSE Director (EMEA) and will be Business Partner to the UK Operational Lead SVP.
The HSE Manager UK will provide HSE leadership, ensuring alignment between day‑to‑day operations, project execution and broader UK organizational objectives. Operating broadly across an Operational HSE environment the role influences decisions, behaviors, and outcomes to drive strong HSE performance across the UK.
The HSE Manager UK will work closely with Operational and Project Management Teams to ensure their business and project areas are aligned with company‑wide initiatives, HSE strategies, and long‑term priorities. They will have experience and understanding of HSE strategy, organizational culture, and operational realities, enabling them to deliver solutions that extend beyond the remit of any single function.
The HSE Manager UK will have the capability to lead and guide HSE teams, shape direction, and influence outcomes across all project and operational settings. Responsibilities include driving continuous improvement, strengthening HSE governance, providing HSE leadership, supporting and enabling project HSE delivery, and ensuring consistent implementation of standards and policies across all UK operations.
A key aspect of the HSE Manager UK role is providing direct, hands‑on support to projects across the UK Operation. Beyond strategic oversight, this position will actively engage with project teams in the field—working closely with Project Managers, Site Leaders, and HSE personnel to ensure that HSE requirements are fully understood, embedded, and effectively executed.
Through this visible and practical involvement, the HSE Manager UK will help bridge the gap between functional expectations and operational realities, ensuring that HSE standards are consistently applied and appropriately adapted where necessary.
You will have/bring:
Diploma Qualified, or equivalent, operational, functional and management experience.
Several year experience in a HSE disciplined role.
Experience with large EPC/EPCM projects - detailed design through to EPC execution and close out.
The HSE Manager UK operates with a high degree of autonomy, working proactively and initiating collaboration with peers and stakeholders across the organization.
Experience in effectively communicating and presenting complex proposals and reports to senior level management. Ability to persuade and influence others. Participative management style with a cooperative team approach.

title: Tire Technician VMS Shop (Rotational Schedule) - Prudhoe Bay, AK
description:
This is a remote/ rotational position, working 3 weeks on 3 weeks off in Prudhoe Bay, AK. The typical schedule is 84 hours per week (40 hours straight time and a minimum of 44 hours at time and a half). All meals and lodging are provided by Worley while the employee is on location. Transportation between Anchorage and Prudhoe Bay is provided.
Worley offers a competitive benefits package, with company paid short-term disability, life insurance, paid sick leave, and 4.5% employer match on 401k.
Job Purpose:
Performs tire repair or replacement on equipment ranging in size from light duty vehicles through earth moving equipment at the shop.
Essential Job Functions:
·
Performs tire repair or replacement on vehicles and heavy equipment.
·
Drives a tire truck to remote areas where equipment may be located.
·
Uses jacks, hoists, and other lifting devices to raise equipment, uses pneumatic and hand tools to remove and replace wheels and uses tire machines to remove tires from rims.
·
Performs tire repairs and balancing as required.
·
Prepares inventory of repaired flats on rims to use as backup in shop (if there is one on site), whether transporting them to the field to fix flats or replace them with tires that are flat and brought in for replacement.
·
Works with Parts department and other Tire Technicians on maintaining new tire inventory.
Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:
·
Thorough understanding of tire repair and replacement techniques and processes.
·
Knowledge of tools and equipment necessary to repair and/or replace tires.
·
Ability to operate tools and equipment necessary to repair and/or replace tires.
·
Ability to repair or replace tires in a shop.
·
Ability to repair or replace tires in an arctic environment.
·
Ability to follow all company, client, safety, and regulatory requirements, including, but not limited to; policies, procedures, standards, and guidelines as they relate to this position and the work duties being performed.
Physical Demands/Work Environment:
Work is performed in a remote Arctic environment with limited medical resources. Candidate understands the site is approximately 840 miles (at least 4 hours by air ambulance) from surgical, specialist, and tertiary medical care, and where medical evacuation from this location may be significantly delayed due to weather conditions. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the essential functions of this job, the employee is required to:
Must have ability to stand, walk on level, uneven and slippery surfaces, sit, squat, kneel, crawl, reach through low and high ranges, work overhead, and exhibit normal balance and coordination. These basic physical requirements are essential for safe performance of the job in harsh environments with exposure to very cold temperatures and while wearing arctic gear.
·
Standing for prolonged periods of time.
·
Driving for prolonged periods of time in the dark and inclement weather
·
Ability to climb scaffold, ramps, stairs, equipment, portable ladders, and/or wellhouse/tank/facility fixed ladders of 20 feet or greater.
·
Ability to wear and utilize fall protection within manufacturer specifications.
·
Lift 50 lbs. from floor to waist with two hands.
·
Lift 50 lbs. from floor to shoulder with two hands.
·
Carry 50 lbs. for 15 feet with two hands.
·
Push/pull 60 lbs. sled for 20 feet.
·
Push/pull 90 lbs. cart for 20 feet.
This job description is intended to describe the nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this position. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities and duties required of the job incumbents.  Worley provides reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities, including both applicants and employees, to allow the individual to perform the essential functions of the job, unless doing so would create an undue hardship.
In-Vehicle Monitoring System
: As part of our commitment to safety and accountability, company vehicles are equipped with in-cab cameras and vehicle monitoring systems. These systems may record video and audio, as well as collect GPS location, vehicle speed, harsh braking, rapid acceleration and other driving behaviors. All data is subject to review by management to ensure compliance with company policies and safe driving practices.
·
2-3 years’ experience in the field repairing and replacing tires, either for a commercial vendor or heavy construction equipment company.
·
High school diploma or equivalent (GED).
·
Valid driver’s license and the ability to be covered by Worley auto insurer.
·
North Slope Training Cooperative (NSTC). Worley can provide NSTC certification training if needed.
