description:
We deliver the world’s most complex projects.
Work as part of a collaborative and inclusive team.
Enjoy a varied & challenging role.
Building on our past. Ready for the future
Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia.
Right now, we’re bridging two worlds as we accelerate to more sustainable energy sources, while helping our customers provide the energy, chemicals and resources that society needs now.
We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their portfolio of assets. We solve complex problems by finding integrated data-centric solutions from the first stages of consulting and engineering to installation and commissioning, to the last stages of decommissioning and remediation.
Join us and help drive innovation and sustainability in our projects.
The Role
As a
Senior Electrical Engineer
with Worley, you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
Primary objective
To ensure Health, Safety and Environment has the highest priority in all activities undertaken by Discipline Engineering and Design personnel assigned to the task force.
To delegate and supervise the work of the discipline engineers and designers.
Maintain productivity and technical integrity for the discipline project deliverables.
To advise Department Manager in advance on engineering resources requirement in order to complete all deliverables for the discipline within the allocated staff hour budget and schedule.
Monitor own progress and ensure it comes within project schedule.
To provide all necessary input to the project control and reporting system, including attending review meetings, maintaining the progress report on weekly basis for the discipline, liaising with the project planning engineer for productivity, discipline progress planning, and preparing the discipline section of the monthly report.
Preparation of list of deliverable for the new projects.
Update PM/PEM with weekly report on the work executed, work planned for next week and constraints.
To prepare the discipline Project Design Criteria in accordance with tender scope of work and latest international recommended practises and standards prior to the commencement of any engineering or design activities.
To supervise the discipline design group by close liaison with the lead designer in order to develop practical and economic designs to achieve the project objectives.
Specific Accountabilities
To arrange for the preparation of all discipline design deliverables including philosophies, narratives, operating manuals,  specifications, data sheets, calculations requisitions, and technical tender evaluations, layout drawings, detail drawings, schedules, in accordance with the project requirements and the company procedures and standards.
Preparation of material requisition (Requisition For Quotation), Technical bid evaluation, Vendor drawing review.
To specify and select appropriate equipment to allow the project to develop a practical and economic design.
To ensure that discipline activities are being executed as per budgeted man-hours.
To estimate time and resources requirement for engineering activities in cooperation with Lead Discipline Engineer.
To ensure technical integrity of design deliverables for the disciplin.
To ensure that all document checking and design verification tasks have been completed in accordance with the Company and project procedures before formal document issue.
To review and comment the design documentation prepared by the discipline.
To ensure conformance with customer requirement.
To liaise with other design groups, and to co-ordinate the discipline activities with the other groups to achieve the overall project design objectives in the most efficient manner.
To provide discipline input to the project key documentation during squad checking, or by the issue of key documentation change requests immediately the discipline activities create or identify the need for a change to those documents.
To foster a culture of continuous improvement.
Review of key documents.
Preparation of man hour estimate and list of deliverables for the new proposals.
Maintaining the client’s / other discipline comments on the deliverables.
Regular interaction with all members of group, provide guidance and monitor correctness and progress of the assigned jobs.
To review of other discipline / Vendor engineering documents/drawing.
Supervise and ensure proper maintenance of Record prints, Check prints, Commented prints and relevant data sheets / drawings from other discipline.
To coordinate with project engineer / manager in project close out.
Adherence to Quality Assurance system, applicable procedures, Design basis, Applicable design guides / Standards / Specifications as applicable.
Safety – Responsible for personal safety safe working practices for the CSG, etc. Understand and follow OH&S procedures.
About You
To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
Degree in Electrical engineering (B.E. or B. Tech).
16 years + plus design experience within the hydrocarbons.
Familiarity with national and international standards such as IS, IEC, BS, OISD,  IE Rules.
Experience in use of electrical system software such as EDSA, ETAP.

title: Crane & Equipment Operator / Wells Intervention Tech (Rotational Schedule) - Prudhoe Bay, AK
description:
This is a remote/ rotational position, working two weeks on and two weeks off or three weeks on and three weeks off, in Prudhoe Bay, AK. The typical schedule is 84 hours per week (40 hours straight time and a minimum of 44 hours at time and a half). All meals and lodging are provided by Worley while the employee is on location. Transportation between Anchorage and Prudhoe Bay is provided.
Worley offers a competitive benefits package, with company paid short-term disability, life insurance, paid sick leave, and 4.5% employer match on 401k.
Job Purpose:
Operates equipment which lifts, hoists, or moves materials for maintenance or construction purposes. The position is assigned to a crew and will assist in manual labor, i.e., hardline rig up, Well tie in, API bolt up, etc. Equipment operations are only part of the duties.
Essential Job Functions:
·
Operate various equipment consisting of boom trucks, Grove cranes, and 45-to-90-ton hydraulic cranes.
·
Moves hand levers, adjusts hand wheels and depresses pedals to drive machines and control attachments such as swing booms.
·
Pre-check and inspect all equipment before operation, which includes checking the oil, fuel, general and visual inspection of the entire chassis (depending on the type of each equipment being operated) windshield, all mirrors, blade, tracks, wheel rims, thumping each tire and lug nuts, oil levels within wheel wells, and checking (while in operation) all moving parts such as handles, levers, and steering wheels.
·
Check equipment operation log to see when vehicle was last maintained, such as oil change and lube jobs and make pre-operation notations in it pertaining to operating the designated piece of equipment that day.
·
Notify foremen of recognized faulty equipment and red-tag it so that it will be unsafe to operate, until it is repaired and declared safe to operate by the mechanic.
·
Attend training sessions and toolbox equipment/safety meetings required by organization.
·
Ensure that crane has annual certifications.
·
The position is required to perform physical labor when crane/equipment operations are not necessary.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
·
Knowledge of computerized components in various kinds of machinery.
·
Knowledge of the functional operation, purpose, capabilities, and limitations of any piece of equipment qualified to operate.
·
Knowledge of safe equipment operations and maintenance of equipment.
·
Skills in operating boom trucks and hydraulic cranes.
·
Ability to read and understand the results and what each gauge signifies on each piece of equipment being operated.
·
Ability to read, interpret or use capacity charts, rigging diagrams and common hand signals.
·
Ability to demonstrate the safe accessories within the range of each piece of equipment operated.
·
Must be able to follow all company, client, safety, and regulatory requirements, including, but not limited to, policies, procedures, standards, and guidelines as they relate to this position and the work duties being performed.
·
Ability to work at heights.
Physical Demands/Work Environment:
Work is performed in a remote Arctic environment with limited medical resources. Candidate understands the site is approximately 840 miles (at least 4 hours by air ambulance) from surgical, specialist, and tertiary medical care, and where medical evacuation from this location may be significantly delayed due to weather conditions. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the essential functions of this job, the employee is required to:
·
Must have ability to stand, walk on level, uneven and slippery surfaces, sit, squat, kneel, crawl, reach through low and high ranges, work overhead, and exhibit normal balance and coordination. These basic physical requirements are essential for safe performance of the job in harsh environments with exposure to very cold temperatures and while wearing arctic gear.
·
Standing for prolonged periods of time.
·
Driving for prolonged periods of time in the dark and inclement weather
·
Ability to climb scaffold, ramps, stairs, equipment, portable ladders, and/or wellhouse/tank/facility fixed ladders of 20 feet or greater.
·
Ability to wear and utilize fall protection within manufacturer specifications.
·
Lift 50 lbs. from floor to waist with two hands.
·
Lift 50 lbs. from floor to shoulder with two hands.
·
Carry 50 lbs. for 15 feet with two hands.
·
Push/pull 60 lbs. sled for 20 feet.
·
Push/pull 90 lbs. cart for 20 feet.
This job description is intended to describe the nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this position. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities and duties required of the job incumbents.
Worley
provides reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities, including both applicants and employees, to allow the individual to perform the essential functions of the job, unless doing so would create an undue hardship.
In-Vehicle Monitoring System
: As part of our commitment to safety and accountability, company vehicles are equipped with in-cab cameras and vehicle monitoring systems. These systems may record video and audio, as well as collect GPS location, vehicle speed, harsh braking, rapid acceleration and other driving behaviors. All data is subject to review by management to ensure compliance with company policies and safe driving practices.
·
Must be able to acquire a Class A CDL with hazardous endorsement within 6 months of employment and ability to be insured by Worley auto insurer
.
·
NCCCO TLL large telescopic (swing cab) certification.
·
High school diploma or equivalent (GED).
·
North Slope Training Cooperative (NSTC). Worley can provide NSTC certification training if needed.
Preferred Qualifications:
·
Current class A CDL with tanker, hazmat endorsement and current DOT medical card.
·
Two (2) years North Slope experience.
·
Two (2) years’ experience operating loader, forklift, boom truck and other miscellaneous oilfield equipment.
·
Two (2) years Oil Filed experience.
·
Alaska resident capable of short notice mobilization.

description:

Objetivo:
Responsabilizarse por la realización y asignación de trabajos complejos o con alto nivel de dificultad, que impliquen un juicio independiente o criterio en relación con las labores de dibujo o modelamiento, para determinar un curso de acción de los proyectos, consistente con las políticas y metas funcionales establecidas por la organización.
Habilidad para liderar y/o capacitar a personas menos experimentadas en dibujo y modelamiento.
Responsabilidades:
•
Por lo general, tener más de 5 años de experiencia en disciplinas relevantes.  Debe tener una comprensión competente de algunos códigos, estándares y buenas prácticas de la industria.
•    Tener experiencia en la realización de labores de dibujo y modelamiento en ingenierías conceptuales, básicas y detalladas de proyectos de la industria (Oil & Gas, Minería, Infraestructura, entre otros).
•    Tomar decisiones responsables para el curso de entregables de dibujo y modelamiento. Las decisiones difíciles, complejas o inusuales generalmente se remiten a miembros de disciplina más experimentados como ingenieros, sobre quienes recae toda la responsabilidad del diseño.

Puede ser supervisor de actividades o también tener supervisión para determinación de  precisión, integridad y cumplimiento de los objetivos. •    Ser competente en el uso de herramientas como Microsoft 365 y Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint y Teams). Puede navegar por las páginas de la intranet, realizar búsquedas y recuperar información. Puede organizar información de múltiples fuentes y retenerla según el formato y las políticas establecidas.
•    Trabajar de manera competente y eficiente en herramientas de diseño especializado, análisis y modelado, y métodos centrados en datos interdisciplinarios.
•    Construir relaciones apropiadas, constructivas y efectivas en toda la organización; usar la diplomacia y el tacto, ser accesible, comunicarse con claridad, precisión y coherencia tanto verbalmente como por escrito. Emplear los principios de la escucha activa y fomentar la retroalimentación desde y hacia los demás.
•    Trabajar en un equipo con visibilidad para las partes interesadas en altos niveles, ser capaz de trabajar y vincularse con múltiples equipos y partes interesadas, ser capaz de priorizar las cargas de trabajo y ayudar a otros miembros del equipo a lograr sus objetivos.
•    Lograr los resultados establecidos por sí mismo y por otros, cumpliendo con los plazos definidos.
•    Esforzarse por lograr objetivos ambiciosos, demostrando entusiasmo, persistencia y tenacidad.
•    Dividir y priorizar el trabajo en tareas ejecutables.
•    Responzabilizarse por el trabajo producido y asegurase de que sea "correcto desde la primera vez".
•    Adaptarse al aprendizaje e implementación de nuevos conceptos con mayor complejidad.
•    Examinar los problemas cuidadosa y minuciosamente y comprender sus interdependencias para proponer soluciones.

.

The role ensures safe, timely, and cost effective delivery, technical integrity, regulatory compliance, and client satisfaction, while driving continuous improvement and digital ways of working across the project lifecycle.
The PM/ PE shall be experienced electrical engineer having technical competencies in Electrical distribution system designs, capable of producing equipment sizing calculations, Protection and Control philosophies, Single line Diagrams, Selection of equipment’s based on
Hazardous Area Classification, Earthing and Lightning calculations, Procurement and layout engineering.
Experienced in preparation of frame agreement for PDCs, Switchgears with an intention of standardization, minimizing spares and defining the prices at the beginning of project.
The PM/PE shall be responsible for leading a team of professionals and will be responsible for the delivery of the projects in time and in line with organizational strategy in a safe & fully compliant manner to the satisfaction of the client.

The PM/PE shall have a mindset of operational excellence and continuous improvement. Optimal use of resources with a focus on Technical Integrity, Safety, sustainability and digitization will be a key aspect of this role.
Review Workhour estimates and Schedule of deliverables for the discipline on projects carried out by respective Leads.
Involve in major issues & problem solving, achieving Project milestones and guide leads in implementation of Lessons Learned across Program/Projects.
Resolve Interface issues by coordinating with other discipline Lead/ section heads.
Project Management & Planning
Own overall scope, schedule, cost, risk, and quality for assigned PDC replacement and electrical upgrade projects, from concept through commissioning and handover.
Develop and maintain project execution plans, WBS, resource plans, budgets, and look ahead schedules, report progress and variances with clear recovery actions.
Lead interdisciplinary coordination (civil/structural, HVAC, instrumentation, automation) and interface management across engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning (EPCC).
Prepare, review, and endorse Project Change Requests (PCRs); steward change control and configuration management.
Organize internal alignment (IAP) sessions, technical reviews, HAZIDs/HAZOPs (as applicable), constructability and maintainability workshops.
Electrical Engineering & Design
Perform and/or review calculations, sizing, and selection for MV/LV switchgear, bus ducts, transformers, MCCs, drives, UPS, earthing/grounding, lightning protection, cables, and protection systems.
Lead PDC replacement engineering: single line diagrams (SLDs), GA/layouts, room layouts, cable routing, protection coordination, short circuit & arc flash studies, load flow, motor starting, and harmonic analysis.
Define technical specifications, data sheets, and evaluation criteria; review vendor documents and FAT procedures; drive standardization and lessons learned.
Ensure designs meet statutory, code, and client standards (e.g., IEEE, NEMA, IEC) and cybersecurity considerations for intelligent electronic devices (IEDs).
About You
To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
B.E./B.Tech in Electrical Engineering (M.E./M.Tech preferred).
2–5 years (Project Engineer) or 10–15 years (Electrical Engineer) of experience in industrial/commercial power systems with demonstrable PDC/switchgear replacement and brownfield upgrade projects.
Hands on exposure to MV/LV systems (up to 33 kV typical), protection & controls, earthing/grounding, and commissioning.

title: Electrical Engineer Level I
description:
We deliver the world’s most complex projects.
Work as part of a collaborative and inclusive team .
Enjoy a varied & challenging role.
Building on our past. Ready for the future
Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia.
Right now, we’re bridging two worlds as we accelerate to more sustainable energy sources, while helping our customers provide the energy, chemicals and resources that society needs now.
We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their portfolio of assets. We solve complex problems by finding integrated data-centric solutions from the first stages of consulting and engineering to installation and commissioning, to the last stages of decommissioning and remediation. Join us and help drive innovation and sustainability in our projects.
The Role
As an  Electrical Engineer Level I with Worley,
you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
Business Development Support
Assists business development activities by maintaining an up to date personal profile and resume.
Builds positive working relationships with external parties such as the customer, suppliers, and contractors.
Business Operations
May support the business by communicating team resource loading and skill requirements to a direct supervisor. Ensures the project work is covered for vacation and unplanned absences.
Mentors/trains and supports the delivery of training. Assists in the employee performance review process. Facilitates coverage of activities when people leave the team. Encourages knowledge of and compliance with requirements and processes.
Works to resolve inter-discipline, vendor, and customer issues. Ensures discipline technical work and team activities meet all health, safety, environmental, and security requirements.
Technical Competency
Supports adherence to generally accepted engineering and design practices, regulatory requirements, and customer specifications. Supports the standardization of equipment specifications, drawings, and document templates.
Contributes to the understanding of technical knowledge, legal requirements, and customer specifications whenever viable and lawful.
Uses local/global standards to support technical excellence. Supports the processes for checking, peer reviews, and incorporation of comments and findings.
Project Execution
Knows the discipline scope/cost/time requirements, assists the team to meet expectations, and coordinates with other disciplines to ensure project success. Implements innovative solutions, technology advances, and methods to effectively deal with working out of sequence.
May support management of project change and progressing for the discipline and works with the Project Management Team to take corrective actions regarding any issues, staffing requirements, scope changes, progressing, or other events that could affect project completion and/or profitability.
Plans discipline quality, monitors quality activities, squad checking, drives and participates in squad checking, recommends improvements, and takes action where required.
Project Deliverables
Gathers data from multiple sources and prepares engineering studies, analyses, calculations, etc. Crafts recommendations and creates final documentation.
Determines technical issues, defines alternate solutions, establishes pros/cons for multiple solutions, and makes recommendations through official project documents such as technical queries, technical deviations, etc. Creates final documentation incorporating all relevant information and pursues customer approval.
May review similar documentation to assist others and reviews/authorizes work done by direct reports.
Procurement Support
Incorporates information from multiple sources into equipment/material specifications, data sheets, testing requirements, and material requisitions.
Participates in bid clarifications, conducts bid evaluations, completes inter-discipline vendor information review and approval, and finalizes other certification activities. May review similar documentation to assist others and reviews/authorizes work done by direct reports.
Site Support
Seeks input from knowledgeable sources, may participate in constructability, operability, and maintainability reviews, and incorporates requirements into engineering/design. Works with site personnel to resolve issues.
May create plans or documents that supports construction, testing, commissioning, operations, maintenance, or decommissioning.
May provide on-site support for construction, commissioning, or turn over.
About You
To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
Intermediate level position following defined processes and precedents to complete assigned tasks with increasing independence specific to area of specialty. Normally regarded as a continuing portion of a design engineer's training and development.
Awarded a 4 or 5 year technical degree in science or engineering. Will be actively licensed with a local engineering governing body where required by law.
Training in leadership, project execution, risk management, or quality.
Typically has 3+ years of relevant discipline experience. Has an intermediate understanding of regulations, codes, manufacturing standards, and industry standard practices.
Experience working in a related industry such as environmental, operations, maintenance, fabrication, or construction. Skilled in estimating project costs and writing proposal content.
Recommendations are limited to the solution of the problems rather than the end result.  Refers unusual decisions to more senior discipline members.
Works under broad direction and technical guidance with regular weekly interaction with supervisor. Broad duties assigned weekly to monthly. Work is reviewed for accuracy, adequacy, and conformance with prescribed procedures.
Typically up to 2 direct reports consisting of less senior engineers and designers within the same discipline, but has no authority for performance evaluations impacting pay.
Proficiently communicate ideas and concepts, developing the ability to persuade and influence others as needed.
An intermediate knowledge of Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and Teams. Can navigate intranet pages, conduct searches, and retrieve information. Can organize information from many sources and retain as per the prescribed format and policies.
Competent in Microsoft Access and PowerPoint. Able to touch type. Proficient  in specialty engineering or design tools, analytics and modelling, and cross-discipline data centric methods.
Assume hands-on management and implementation of all relevant company HSE requirements. Drive Safe and Sustainable engineering outcomes throughout the asset lifecycle via the application of SEAL. Role-model a commitment to personal well-being and a pro-active approach to continuously improving health, safety and environmental performance.
Builds appropriate, constructive, and effective business relationships throughout the organization; uses diplomacy and tact; is approachable; communicates clearly, accurately, and consistently both verbally and in written matters. Employs the principles of active listening and encourages feedback from others.
Enjoys working in a small high calibre team with high visibility to senior stakeholders. Able to work and liaise with multiple teams and stakeholders, able to priorities workloads and help other team members to achieve team goals.
Achieves results set by self and others, meets timelines, pushes to achieve stretch goals, and demonstrates enthusiasm, persistence and tenacity. Breaks down work into executable tasks. Acts accountable for work produced and ensures it is "right the first time.”
Deals with new concepts and complexity comfortably. Examines problems carefully and thoroughly and understands their interdependencies. Can pull information and ideas from many sources and see the importance of many factors.

title: Sr. Telecom Commissioning Engineer
location: Ruwais, Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
description:
JOB PURPOSE
Be part of multi discipline team.
Constantly identify bottlenecks for progress on construction and proactively take action to resolve the same.
Monitor coordination of Interfaces between the EPC Contractors and provide clarifications and/or guidance on resolutions of any conflicts arising during execution.
Construction supervision as per approved IPMT organigram for SITE.
Coordination with COMPANY’s operations for the easement of construction activities and interfaces.
Review of various completion documentation (e.g., Mechanical Completion Dossiers) to ascertain proper compilation and certification.
Ensure that all procedures which are approved for construction drawings, risk assessments, permits,  NOC’s,  environmental restrictions studies  JSA/FRA’s and safety reviews are in place and are adhered to during all the phases of the project.
To ensure Company interests are protected through implementation of the contract requirements, regulations, and sound execution/construction practices, as well as following all the HSSE practices and quality norms.
Coordinate the “Right First Time” start-up concept.
Coordinate the handover of final PROJECT Documents to COMPANY.
Coordinate the clearance of Punch Lists works.
Having a working understanding of AWP (Advanced Work Packages such as those being utilized on this project).
KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES & RESPONSIBILITIES
Review and provide input to the overall construction plan, procedures and construction requirements identified in the EPC Contract to ensure constructability.
Review of construction organisation and manning.
Review construction plans and detailed procedures.
Review tie-in philosophy, tie-in package & relevant procedures.
Hands on experience in Oil & Gas, Petrochemical plants.
Monitor the EPC Contractor’s allocation of construction resources in consideration of relative priorities to meet the construction program and recommend any appropriate corrective action where shortage of resources might prejudice the program.
Review and ensure that all construction procedures, method statements and Inspection & Test Plans are issued as final approved documents before start of any related work.
Monitor and manage inspection of the construction work performed by the EPC Contractor and/or its subcontractors to verify that such work is performed in compliance with the approved procedures and specifications, and that the workmanship is in accordance with appropriate standards of quality.
Monitor and ensure that the work is performed in strict compliance with the safety procedures and requirements.
Ensure that the EPC Contractor has mobilised representatives of VENDORS and/or LICENSORS as required to support the construction activities.
Monitor the progress of work at SITE against the PROJECT Schedule.
Monitor the development of punch lists and close out of listed items as WORKS progress.
Monitor and ensure that the EPC Contractor provides all reports and test records in accordance with the provisions of the EPC Contract.
Be fully conversant with HSEQ plan.
Review Mechanical Completion/Pre-commissioning Manual.
Review Contractor’s request for issuance of Mechanical Completion Certificate(s) and make recommendation to Management on acceptability.
Participate in inspection, site installation, loop / function, site acceptance tests and, endorse inspection and test reports confirming adherence to project specifications and applicable international codes and standards for the following systems / networks:
Outdoor Fiber Optic Cable Network between CCB (installation, termination, testing) and remote buildings and OSP (Outside plant) to NMTR.
Indoor fiber and copper cables (SCS) from telecoms room to end user areas within a building – IDF, MDF, Trays/conduits and cable containment system.
Indoor network equipment such as CISCO Switches, Patch Panels for FO cables and Structured cabling.
Telecom and data center cabinets (free standing and wall mounted).
Public Address General Alarm system (PAGA) including controller, network switches, indoor, outdoor speakers, beacons etc.,
TETRA radio systems including base stations, hand-held radios, vehicle mounted radios, VHF marine radios, antennas and digital remote / BSFR, DAS etc.,
Wireless LAN (Wi-Fi) including Access points (AP), Wireless LAN controller (WLC).
Security Closed Circuit Television System (CCTV) including servers, indoor and outdoor cameras, network switches etc.,
PABX systems including VOIP phones, voice gateways and analog phones (indoor and outdoor), video conference systems.
ACS (Access control systems) including controllers, door locks and access keys.
LAN components such as network switches, firewalls and security equipment.
Participate and provide guidance for coverage studies of following systems.
TETRA radio coverage for Distributed Antenna System (DAS).
Wi-Fi .
Coverage/audibility studies for PAGA.
Participate in integration tests between
TETRA
Telephones
PAGA
FGS
QUALIFICATIONS, EXPERIENCE, KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS
A degree in Engineering with minimum 10 years’ experience within in major oil/gas projects in similar position. Also the candidates should have considerable oil & gas EPC or PMC exposure in their working specialization.
UAE/ME experience is a must including construction exposure in brown field oil&gas / Petrochemicals projects.
TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES
Demonstrate knowledge of regulations, codes, standards, and safety.
Demonstrate knowledge of materials.
Be able to understand solution techniques and independently verify the results.
Safety awareness: be aware of safety risks inherent in the design; and Demonstrate Safety Awareness on site and possible safety authorization/certificate as appropriate.
Demonstrate understanding of systems as well as of components of systems.
Understand the concept of quality control.
GCC experience, UAE experience is preferred.
Site based experience; brown field work is a plus.
Excellent time management skills with a proven ability to meet deadlines.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to prioritize tasks.

Maintain detailed logs of installed steel, concrete, and structural elements for reporting, billing, and earned value measurement.
Identify, investigate, and document variances between reported and actual quantities.
Work closely with field supervision and project controls teams to deliver precise weekly structural quantity reporting.
Promote safe field practices and ensure compliance with company and site safety standards.
Provide guidance on structural quantity surveying systems, processes, and tools, supporting colleagues and troubleshooting as needed.

Proven ability to work effectively in the field while applying analytical and reporting skills.

Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate across diverse teams.
A solid understanding of structural field systems, processes, and tools, with the ability to coach and troubleshoot as needed.

title: Project Control Specialist II
description:
We deliver the world’s most complex projects.
Work as part of a collaborative and inclusive team.
Enjoy a varied & challenging role.
Building on our past. Ready for the future
Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia.
Right now, we’re bridging two worlds as we accelerate to more sustainable energy sources, while helping our customers provide the energy, chemicals and resources that society needs now.
We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their portfolio of assets. We solve complex problems by finding integrated data-centric solutions from the first stages of consulting and engineering to installation and commissioning, to the last stages of decommissioning and remediation. Join us and help drive innovation and sustainability in our projects.
The Role
As a Project Control Specialist II with Worley,
you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
Lead and guide the Project Controls team for Schedule and Cost function on the Project.
Work with Project leadership team in alignment and strategic discussions on the project.
Develop and finalise the Project Controls Plan as per Project requirements and interface with Client and internal stakeholders.
Lead and develop the Progress measurement system for the project based on the contractual reporting requirements and processes.
Actively participate in Schedule development and guide the team to the required Planning and scheduling requirements.
Conduct / lead Schedule workshops, IAP sessions and focus discussions on Schedule baselining and forecast exercises as required.
Review, Tracking & monitoring Schedule & Critical areas through LEM and Scrums, raising the flag for the delays & areas of concerns.
Establish WBS and CBS required for the project as per the reporting requirements in line with the Client discussions.
Interact with Project and department stakeholders in functional discussions and support required in delivering the Projects assigned.
Preparation and analysis of Project performance statistics and analytics as appropriate.
Lead to set up Project Cost reports, internal monitoring metrics and other reporting requirements.
Monitoring & controlling the cost by various analysis and time to time information Management about the risk areas.
Performing Risk Analysis on the Schedule and provide inputs / recommendations.
Generating various reports like Progress S-curves, Lookahead Plan, Variance Analysis, Productivity Analysis.
Invoicing, preparing Cash flow and presenting in the APEX monthly level meeting.
Daily/Weekly/Monthly reports
Attend Internal and Client review meetings as required to present the Project performance, Concerns, and recovery plans etc.
Work closely with the Project and Engineering managers to ensure proactive approach on addressing project performance and recovery measures all times.
Mentor and guide junior team members and impart knowledge transfer time to time.
Participate internal innovative forums and contribute for the Digital growth in project delivery wherever possible.
Preparation of project cost reports and provide forecast analysis and trends of the project.
Liaise effectively with multidisciplinary teams, fostering collaborative relationships, and ensuring alignment between planning, execution, and project objectives.
About You
To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
Tertiary qualifications in Graduate in Engineering/Technology.
15+ years of experience in Working for similar type Projects/Industry experience.
Proven leadership and communication skills
Extensive experience in Oil & Gas, energy sector & Chemicals.
Sound knowledge of Planning, Cost control and Monitoring.
A dedication to client satisfaction
Excellent relationship building and stakeholder management skills.
You will be an enthusiastic team player, with excellent stakeholder management skills.
Proactive thinking and solution-oriented delivery.

title: Lead Completions Coordinator
description:

Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts. We partner with customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their assets. Play an integral role in bringing large-scale refinery, LNG, and chemical plant projects safely and efficiently to completion. As a Completions Lead at Worley, you’ll help ensure that complex downstream systems are prepared, tested, and handed over seamlessly. You’ll be at the heart of project delivery—connecting construction and commissioning teams to ensure every system performs as designed and meets client expectations.
PURPOSE OF THE ROLE
You will be responsible for leading and coordinating pre-commissioning and completions activities across a downstream facility. Your focus will be on achieving readiness, safety, and quality in every system turned over to operations.

· Plan, lead, and oversee discipline-specific pre-commissioning activities (mechanical, electrical, instrumentation, etc.) across downstream project scopes.
· Develop and implement pre-commissioning procedures, schedules, and readiness checklists that align with project and client standards.
· Manage punch list generation, classification, and resolution—coordinating with QA/QC, construction, and subcontractor teams to achieve timely closeout.
· Support preparation of system turnover packages, ensuring documentation, certifications, and test records are complete and traceable.
· Facilitate system handover meetings and ensure alignment between commissioning, operations, and client teams.
· Supervise and mentor pre-commissioning engineers and coordinators, promoting teamwork, accountability, and technical excellence.
· Serve as the deputy point of contact for the Pre-Commissioning Manager, representing completions and pre-commissioning functions with clients and internal stakeholders.
· Use completions management systems (Orbit, WinPCS, MCPlus, or equivalent) to track progress, documentation, and performance.
· Generate accurate and timely reports and dashboards for project leadership and client review.
WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO THE ROLE
· A minimum of 8 years of experience in pre-commissioning or completions on large-scale refinery, LNG, petrochemical, or chemical plant projects.
· Strong technical understanding of downstream system boundaries, pre-commissioning processes, and turnover methodologies.
· Solid working knowledge of industry codes and standards (API, ASME, IEC, and others relevant to downstream facilities).
· Hands-on experience with completions software and document management systems.
· Demonstrated leadership and communication skills with the ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders and priorities.

Play an integral role in leading the pre-commissioning, commissioning, and start-up of large-scale power generation facilities. You will ensure systems are designed, installed, tested, and operated in a manner that achieves operational readiness, regulatory compliance, and optimal performance prior to handover. The role blends engineering rigor, operational insight, and people leadership to deliver successful outcomes across the full project lifecycle.
Core Responsibilities
You will be responsible for:
•    Providing overall commissioning leadership for steam, gas turbine, and combined-cycle power generation projects, from early planning through start-up and handover.
•    Directing commissioning planning deliverables, including execution strategies, systemization, schedules, procedures, and resource plans.
•    Working closely with Engineering to define and validate all engineering deliverables, including load versus supply curves that support commissioning and start-up activities.
•    Establishing start-up sequencing, durations, and logic through commissioning and start-up, forming a template that supports early project schedule development (Level 2–3) and procurement flow paths.
•    Integrating commissioning activities into the overall project schedule, ensuring strong links to construction, procurement, and vendor milestones.
•    Managing commissioning manpower, vendor resources, and specialist support, including Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) for critical packages.
•    Providing hands-on technical leadership for complex systems including boilers, steam turbines, generators, balance of plant, instrumentation, and controls.
•    Conducting or overseeing thermal performance, heat rate, fluid dynamics, and system stress analysis using industry tools such as ANSYS or Thermoflex.
•    Ensuring compliance with applicable standards and regulations, including ASME PTC 22, OSHA, environmental requirements, NERC, and TCEQ.
•    Driving a strong safety culture during commissioning and start-up, with clear procedures, risk assessments, and field leadership.
•    Validating operational readiness by ensuring equipment operates safely, reliably, and at peak efficiency prior to turnover to operations.
•    Supporting capital and O&M budgets, commissioning cost control, and performance optimization initiatives.
•    Coordinating closely with project management, construction, operations, and client teams to ensure seamless project delivery.
•    Supporting grid integration and operational readiness with regional transmission organizations such as ERCOT.
#LI-JS4
What you’ll bring to the role:
•    Extensive commissioning and start-up experience in power generation, with a strong focus on gas turbines, steam systems, and combined-cycle facilities.
•    A First Class Power Engineer or Chief certification, enabling supervision of power plants of any capacity, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
•    Demonstrated capability to act as Chief Engineer or Senior Shift Supervisor, with accountability for operations, maintenance, and safety.
•    A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, or a First Class Power Engineering Certificate or equivalent.
•    Strong working knowledge of Rankine cycle theory, power plant thermodynamics, instrumentation, controls, and balance-of-plant systems.
•    Proven experience leading commissioning planning, procedure development, O&M deliverables, and start-up execution on large capital projects.
•    Solid project management capability, including schedule integration, capital planning, and cost control across commissioning and operations scopes.
•    Experience managing multidisciplinary teams, including mentoring, training, and developing engineers, technicians, and operators.
•    A practical, safety-first mindset with the confidence to make sound technical decisions in high-risk, high-consequence environments.
•    Professional Engineer (PE) licensure is preferred.
Benefits
Feel the energy at Worley with access to a range of benefits including: paid-time off, holiday pay (usually 8 per year in the US), and eligibility to participate in the medical, life, dental, and vision insurance plans, as well as 401K plan.
If you are motivated by complex technical challenges, enjoy leading teams through critical project milestones, and want to shape the future of power generation, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact. Join Worley and bring your commissioning expertise to projects that matter.
About Us
Worley partners with clients across energy, chemicals, and resources to deliver safe, reliable, and sustainable outcomes. We value collaboration, technical excellence, and integrity, and we are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where people can do their best work while helping customers navigate the energy transition.

description:
Building on our past. Ready for the future
Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts. We partner with customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their assets. Location:
Lima, Peru
Employment Type:
Full-time
About the Role
We are seeking a
Senior Study Manager
to lead front-end studies for mining and mineral processing projects, with a strong foundation in
process engineering
and broad multidisciplinary experience. This role is suited to a senior professional capable of managing studies as
investment decision tools
, not merely technical exercises.
The Study Manager will lead multi-discipline studies from
concept through Pre-Feasibility and Feasibility
, acting as the
single point of accountability and primary interface with the client
. The role carries full responsibility for
schedule, cost, scope, and change management
, ensuring that study outcomes are integrated, credible, and decision-ready.
This position plays a key role in shaping the
long-term processing strategy and capital investment roadmap
for future mineral processing facilities.
Key Responsibilities
Study Leadership & Delivery
Lead and manage mining and mineral processing studies from Scoping through PFS/FS, ensuring safety, quality, schedule, and cost objectives are met.
Act as the
single point of contact with the client
and overall authority for study execution.
Define study strategies, manage critical path schedules, and ensure timely delivery of
decision-ready outputs
.
Lead regular reviews of study progress, budgets, resources, risks, and interfaces, addressing issues proactively.
Schedule, Cost, Scope & Change Control
Own the
study schedule and cost control
, ensuring alignment between scope definition, level of maturity, and estimating accuracy.
Work closely with project controls to manage
schedule logic, critical path, cost trending, and forecasting
.
Act as the
manager of all disciplines
, ensuring clear scope definition, roles, responsibilities, and interfaces across engineering, mining, process, infrastructure, environment, permitting, and economics.
Maintain strict
scope control
, preventing unmanaged scope growth and ensuring alignment with study objectives.
Lead
change management
, assessing the technical, schedule, cost, and business case impacts of changes and supporting informed decision-making with the client.
Ensure all approved changes are documented and reflected in study deliverables, estimates, and schedules.
Technical Integration & Process Oversight
Provide senior oversight of process engineering and metallurgical inputs, ensuring assumptions are realistic, consistent, and appropriate for study maturity.
Integrate process design with mining, infrastructure, tailings, water, environmental, and permitting inputs.
Coordinate internal subject matter experts and external specialists or technology providers.
Ensure study solutions are
constructible, operable, and executable
, with early consideration of brownfield constraints, tie-ins, staging, and ramp-up.
Business Case, Economics & Investment Strategy
Lead integration of technical outputs into CAPEX, OPEX, and economic models.
Evaluate alternative development options and trade-offs to maximize project value.
Ensure studies clearly articulate value drivers, risks, sensitivities, and capital phasing to support informed investment decisions.
Procurement, Contracting & Execution Input
Provide strategic input to
procurement and contracting strategies
at study level, including packaging options, long-lead items, and interfaces with OEMs and technology providers.
Ensure alignment between process design decisions, procurement strategy, execution approach, and overall schedule and cost.
Client & Stakeholder Engagement
Maintain a strong client focus, understanding objectives and ensuring study outcomes meet expectations.
Lead technical workshops, option selection sessions, and study reviews with clients and internal leadership.
Act as a trusted advisor, capable of clearly communicating complex technical and commercial topics to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Support business development activities in a
seller–doer
capacity, including proposal preparation and client engagement.
Governance, Risk & Assurance
Ensure study risks, assumptions, and uncertainties are clearly identified, managed, and communicated.
Comply with internal quality, health, safety, and environmental management systems.
Support internal and external reviews, audits, and assurance processes.
Qualifications
Degree in Metallurgical Engineering, Mineral Processing, Chemical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
15–25+ years
of experience in mining and mineral processing projects, with a strong background in process engineering.
Demonstrated experience leading Scoping, PFS, and FS studies within an engineering consulting or owner environment.
Proven ability to manage complex, multi-discipline teams and deliver decision-focused study outcomes.
Strong understanding of mineral processing circuits; experience with gravity-dominated or specialty minerals is an advantage.
Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
High level of proficiency in report writing, presentations, and study documentation.
Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.
Desirable Attributes
Experience in tin processing projects or plants.
Experience working with external technology providers or licensors.
Bilingual Spanish / English (required).

accessibility adjustments
, please make sure to mention it in your application.

,

Job Purpose:
The Wash Bay Attendant uses high-pressure, high volume wash system to clean equipment and vehicles.
Essential Job Functions:
·
Operates high-pressure water system to clean vehicles, heavy equipment, tanks and trucks, as well as the interior and exterior of vessels, from 100 bbl. to 400 bbl. upright tanks, Vac trucks and guzzlers.
·
Use and operation of vac-trailers, super suckers, Cusco’s, chemical trucks and non-mobile trailers.
·
Opening and closing hatches on all vessels that come into the wash bay.
·
Spotting equipment in and out of the wash bay using unified hand signals.
·
Work in confined spaces with high pressure water, hand tools and air tools for long periods of time.
·
Use, cleaning and maintenance of sumps, sump pumps and sump to holding tank fluid transfer.
·
Read and understand a north-slope manifest and differentiate between class-1 and class-2 materials.
·
Utilizes brushes, brooms, soaps, and solvents when necessary to facilitate removal of sludge, grease and oil.
·
Responsible for keeping wash bay building and equipment clean and may perform routine maintenance on equipment such as pumps and hoses.
·
Complete PTSP (Pre-Task Safety Planning) card prior to starting any job.
·
Routinely operate Worley/client light and/or medium duty vehicles.
·
Safely climb ladders of various heights.

·
Ability to work in confined spaces.
·
Possess current general knowledge of practical laborer skills and be able to work safely.
·
Must be able to follow all company, client, safety, and regulatory requirements, including, but not limited to, policies, procedures, standards and guidelines as they relate to this position and the work duties being performed.
Physical Demand/Work Environment:
Work is performed in a remote Arctic environment with limited medical resources. Candidate understands the site is approximately 840 miles (at least 4 hours by air ambulance) from surgical, specialist, and tertiary medical care, and where medical evacuation from this location may be significantly delayed due to weather conditions. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the essential functions of this job, the employee is required to:
·
Must have ability to stand, walk on level, uneven and slippery surfaces, sit, squat, kneel, crawl, reach through low and high ranges, work overhead, and exhibit normal balance and coordination. These basic physical requirements are essential for safe performance of the job in harsh environments with exposure to very cold temperatures and while wearing arctic gear.
·
Standing for prolonged periods of time.
·
Driving for prolonged periods of time in the dark and inclement weather
·
Ability to climb scaffold, ramps, stairs, equipment, portable ladders, and/or wellhouse/tank/facility fixed ladders of 20 feet or greater.
·
Ability to wear and utilize fall protection within manufacturer specifications.
·
Lift 50 lbs. from floor to waist with two hands.
·
Lift 50 lbs. from floor to shoulder with two hands.
·
Carry 50 lbs. for 15 feet with two hands.
·
Push/pull 60 lbs. sled for 20 feet.

title: I&E Quality Control Inspector
description:
I&E Quality Control Inspector
Building on our past. Ready for the future.
Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts. We partner with customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their assets. We’re bridging two worlds, moving towards more sustainable energy sources, while helping to provide the energy, chemicals and resources needed now.
I&E Quality Control Inspector
At Worley, quality is foundational to everything we deliver. As an I&E Quality Control Inspector, you play an integral role in ensuring our projects are executed safely, compliantly, and to the highest technical standards—supporting both today’s operational needs and tomorrow’s sustainable outcomes.
Purpose of the role
You will be responsible for verifying that electrical and instrumentation materials, installation, and workmanship meet project specifications, applicable codes, and regulatory requirements. Your work directly contributes to the integrity, reliability, and long-term performance of our projects, reinforcing Worley’s commitment to delivering sustainable change with precision and accountability.
Core Responsibilities
You will be responsible for inspecting materials, workmanship, and construction activities to confirm compliance with project specifications, industry codes, and safety requirements across the project lifecycle.
You collaborate closely with senior inspectors, construction teams, and project stakeholders to identify issues early, troubleshoot challenges, and support effective, timely resolution.
You exercise sound, independent judgment when selecting inspection methods, identifying improvements, and recommending corrective actions, while remaining aligned with company procedures and project objectives.
You ensure all inspection activities and documentation are completed accurately and on schedule, maintaining clear, auditable records that reflect Worley’s quality and sustainability standards.
You review completed work for completeness and accuracy, supporting compliance with regulatory and contractual requirements.
You participate in ongoing training and development to strengthen technical capability, stay current with codes and standards, and contribute to continuous improvement across the team.
You provide guidance and share best practices with peers as needed, fostering a collaborative, high-performance quality culture.
You communicate inspection findings, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, promoting transparency and informed decision-making.
You apply an intermediate understanding of relevant systems, processes, and digital tools used to support quality control and project execution.
#LI-JS4
What you’ll bring to the role
You bring a technical school qualification or an equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience in electrical and instrumentation quality control or a related discipline.
You demonstrate hands-on experience performing quality control inspections and a solid working knowledge of applicable industry codes, standards, and regulatory requirements.
You are confident making decisions in the field, with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently in fast-paced, construction-driven environments.
You are proficient in using inspection tools, testing equipment, and documentation systems required to execute quality activities accurately and efficiently.
You communicate clearly and professionally, building effective working relationships across disciplines, contractors, and project teams.
You bring an intermediate understanding of project systems, workflows, and tools, with a mindset aligned to Worley’s focus on safety, quality, and sustainability.
Benefits
Feel the energy at Worley with access to a range of benefits including paid-time off, holiday pay (usually 8 per year in the US), and eligibility to participate in the medical, life, dental, and vision insurance plans, as well as a 401(k) plan.
If you are motivated by quality, driven by accountability, and want to contribute to projects that balance today’s energy needs with a more sustainable future, we invite you to apply and build your career with Worley.
About Us
Worley is a global professional services company delivering projects and services in the energy, chemicals, and resources sectors. Our people combine deep technical expertise with a shared commitment to safety, integrity, and sustainability—helping our customers succeed while shaping a more resilient future.

description:

Producir ingeniería en la disciplina de tuberías asegurando la seguridad y un alto estándar de calidad en los cálculos y en los entregables de la disciplina en conformidad con los criterios, estándares y normas de diseño.

title: Senior Field Engineer
description:
We deliver the world’s most complex projects.
Work as part of a collaborative and inclusive team.
Enjoy a varied & challenging role.
Building on our past. Ready for the future
Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia.
Right now, we’re bridging two worlds as we accelerate to more sustainable energy sources, while helping our customers provide the energy, chemicals and resources that society needs now.
We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their portfolio of assets. We solve complex problems by finding integrated data-centric solutions from the first stages of consulting and engineering to installation and commissioning, to the last stages of decommissioning and remediation. Join us and help drive innovation and sustainability in our projects.
The Role
As a Senior Field Engineer - Lead Piping with Worley,
you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
Responsible to lead the team of piping engineers for construction supervision and management of the piping works at project site.
Assign/distribute works/work areas to the piping engineers and ensure that.
The process of review of the ‘Issued for Construction’ drawings and seeking clarification based on the established procedure is followed.
Necessary inputs are provided to the Planning Engineer/Team at project site for developing the construction schedule for the piping discipline.
The engineers understand the requirements specified in the contract agreement of the contractors for piping discipline.
The engineers collaborate with the contractors for development of the detailed construction schedule/review the construction schedule, resource status submitted by contractors.
Stage wise inspections are carried out, of works performed by the contractor based on the approved quality plan and necessary documentation for the inspections performed are maintained.
The engineers Review JHAs, method statements and lifting plan (if applicable).
Approval of Quality Plan and Inspection Test Plan of the contractors.
Lead site walk rounds for the piping discipline and participate in quality audits.
Other Attributes:
Supervise for safety to maintain a safe workplace. Ensure that the team of engineers carry out inspections of activities performed by the contractors to confirm compliance to Field HSE Specification. Highlight deficiencies to contractor through formal communication.
Maintain status of front availability and monitor work progress as compared to the approved schedule and highlight deficiencies to the contractor through formal contractual communications.
Monitor contractor’s compliance to various requirements indicated under the contract agreement. Highlight non-conformities to the contractor through formal communication and follow up for compliance.
Lead review meetings with Contractors.
Review and certify the interim and final measurement records submitted by the contractors.
Coordinate with the Contractors for submission of ‘As Built’ mark ups and review of the same.
About You
To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
Job Specific Knowledge: Knowledge of quality control, safe ways of working, resource requirement, sequence of activities, and supervision of construction activities for the respective discipline. Aware of the requirements of various applicable standards (Indian Standards, ASME etc.) for the respective
discipline. Knowledge of statutory requirements, general contract requirements and interpretation of contract clauses.
Industry Specific Experience: Graduate Engineers with minimum 15 years of experience with minimum 3 years of experience of working as Lead Engineer/Area Manager/Superintendent in Oil & Gas Sector and Chemicals.
Education – Qualifications, Accreditation, Training: Graduate in Engineering in respective discipline.
HSE Capability: Knowledge of safe methods of execution of construction activities for the respective discipline.
IT Skills: Proficient in MS Office.
People Skills: Leadership skills, Team Player.
Other: Adaptable, open towards learning and development, person of integrity.
Experience of 13-17 years.
Must have completed one project on EPCM/PMC basis from start till completion in Refineries/Petrochemicals/Chemical Sector.
Should have experience in LSTK Companies.
Moving forward together
We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation.
We’re building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.
And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology.
Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

title: HSE Administrative SASISOPA
description:
Construyendo sobre nuestro pasado. Listos para el futuro
Worley es una firma global de servicios profesionales compuesta por expertos en energía, productos químicos y recursos. Nos asociamos con clientes para entregar proyectos y crear valor durante la vida útil de sus activos. Estamos uniendo dos mundos, avanzando hacia fuentes de energía más sostenibles y al mismo tiempo ayudamos a proporcionar la energía, los productos químicos y los recursos que se necesitan ahora.
Objetivo del cargo:
Dar seguimiento, monitorear, integrar, y dar soporte en la gestión, implementación y cumplimiento de las actividades relacionadas con las exigencias del Proyecto de Construcción Cuxtal II respecto al Sistema de Gestión Integrado (SGI), y el Sistema de Administración de Seguridad Industrial, Seguridad Operativa y Protección al Medio Ambiente (SASISOPA), y demás Políticas y Guías internas, a fin de asegurar el cumplimiento regulatorio acorde al plan de ejecución del proyecto.
Responsabilidades:
•    Supervisar el cumplimiento de todos los elementos contemplados en SGI de Engie Mexico, que deben ser alineados e incorporados según el plan de ejecución del proyecto Cuxtal II, coordinando la conformación de las evidencias adecuadas en tiempo y forma de cada requerimiento, para ser reportado de forma oportuna.
•    Brindar soporte, supervisar y gestionar el desarrollo de las actividades que integran el SASISOPA, para la  adecuada implementación y cumplimiento de las obligaciones legales aplicables según el plan de ejecución del proyecto Cuxtal II. Atender los requerimientos y observaciones emitidas por las entidades regulatorias que vigilan el cumplimiento en materia de SASISOPA.
•    Brindar soporte en la coordinación con las áreas requeridas del proyecto Cuxtal II, para monitorear la información a incorporar (input) de cada una para reportar en forma completa y a tiempo las exigencias de los diversos reportes de cumplimiento interno.
•    Interactuar con el Contratista EPC y/o otras entidades relacionadas con el proyecto Cuxtal II para revisar y asegurar la presentación de evidencias de las Obligaciones del Contrato por parte del Contratista EPC.
•    Validar la información de acuerdo con la Ley Aplicable en materia de SASISOPA.
•    Aceptar o rechazar cierta información proporcionada por el Contratista, sus Subcontratistas o sus Proveedores, de acuerdo con la Ley Aplicable.
•    Coordinar en su caso, las reuniones pertinentes para anticipar las acciones correctivas a emprender a tiempo y prevenir incumplimientos del Contratista EPC.
•    Brindar soporte en el cumplimiento regulatorio del proyecto Cuxtal II, realizando tareas de análisis, identificación, seguimiento y supervisión de cumplimientos, así como la conformación de archivo digital y físico, uso de plataformas electrónicas, y otras tareas administrativas.Asegurar el cumplimiento en todo el personal, salva guardar los activos de las empresas, medio ambiente, por medio del conocimiento y aplicación de las normativad Mexicana y aplicable.
•    Conocimientos avanzados y sólida experiencia en SASISOPA de acuerdo con la legislación aplicable, Sistemas de Gestión Integrados, así como la regulación del Sector Hidrocarburos, durante el ciclo de vida de todo un proyecto.
•    Amplia y sólida experiencia en la gestión, implementación y seguimiento de las actividades relacionadas con el SASISOPA, para las obligaciones contractuales EPC y sus subcontratistas y sus proveedores (si corresponde) de conformidad con la legislación aplicable.
•    Trabajo en equipo. Resolución de problemas. Gestión del tiempo. Atención a los detalles Ética laboral Liderazgo Enfoque en los detalles Capacidad de comunicación
Software, procesos y herramientas:
•    Comprensión avanzada de sistemas, procesos y herramientas relacionadas en el campo de la constriccion en materia de HSE.
•    Capacidad del uso de herramienta de conocimiento y sistemas de procesos para ayudar a otros y resolver problemas.
•    Amplios conocimientos en Microsoft Office

title: Field Change Control
description:
Building on our past. Ready for the future
Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts. We partner with customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their assets. We’re bridging two worlds, moving towards more sustainable energy sources, while helping to provide the energy, chemicals and resources needed now.
Purpose of the role
Play an integral role in managing field-initiated changes so our projects stay safe, efficient and aligned with customer expectations. You’ll act as the connection point between the field, engineering, project controls and construction leadership—making sure changes are identified, documented and assessed with accuracy and speed. Your work helps us maintain the viability of our customers’ assets while supporting their ambitions for lower-carbon, more resilient operations.
Core Responsibilities
You will be responsible for…
Coordinating the end-to-end field change management process, from initial identification to closeout.
Reviewing field change requests for clarity, completeness and feasibility before routing them for technical evaluation.
Facilitating timely engagement between field teams, engineering, procurement and project controls to assess impacts on scope, cost, schedule, materials and constructability.
Tracking and maintaining field change logs and ensuring all information is accurate, current and aligned across project systems.
Supporting constructability reviews by helping teams understand the implications of proposed changes.
Ensuring changes comply with project procedures, safety standards and contractual requirements.
Preparing documentation and supporting records for customer approval processes.
Highlighting potential risks early and collaborating with stakeholders to propose practical solutions.
Communicating the status of field changes with clarity so leadership can make informed decisions quickly.
Helping drive a culture of continuous improvement by sharing lessons learned and supporting updates to field processes where needed.
What you’ll bring to the role
Experience supporting construction, field engineering or project delivery activities in complex industrial environments—energy, chemicals, resources or similar.
A solid understanding of how scope changes affect cost, schedule, materials and risk, and the ability to communicate those impacts clearly.
Strong collaboration skills—you listen, you ask good questions, and you work well with diverse teams who may have competing priorities.
The ability to translate field realities into clear, structured documentation.
Confidence using project systems (such as change management tools, document control platforms and project controls systems).
A practical, solutions-oriented mindset and comfort operating in dynamic field conditions.
Attention to detail, especially when reviewing technical information or coordinating multiple approvals.
A commitment to safety in every decision.
Curiosity and willingness to learn—whether it’s new digital tools, new construction methods or new sustainability-related considerations.
Moving forward together

description:

Develop and maintain construction practices for the project. Control and coordinate construction activities to ensure assigned projects are delivered to the clients satisfaction and according to safety, quality, time and budget parameters.
This role is based onsite in Shreveport, Louisiana in a plant based environment.
Responsibilities:
PHASE IV (DETAILED DESIGN)
Assist in developing construction strategy from owner’s perspective.
Review IFA and IFC Construction Packages and give feedback to project team.
Participate in design/constructability reviews at the EPC office or engineering supplier.
Participate in constructability effort per PMT procedure.
PHASE IV (PROCUREMENT)
Evaluate contractors and service.
Participate in pre–bid walks and assists in evaluating bids.
Assist in answering construction related pre-bid RFI’s from contractors.
Take part in the bid review for field construction packages, as requested.
Assist EPC or construction supplier mobilization to site (trailers, utilities, storage).
Collect and forward to PM any documentation that arrives with materials.
PHASE V (CONSTRUCTION FIELD SUPERVISION) - PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITY
FIELD ACTIVITY for E&I Discipline
Single point of contact for contractors.
Lead pre-construction meeting with successful contractor(s).
Document and answer contractor RFI’s. – i.e. first point of contact.
Pass on to project team any risk of claim or delay from contractors.
Receive and store purchased materials.
Coordinate the project’s lay-down areas.
Assist/Ensure plan for maintenance of stored equipment.
Help distribute previously-stored project provided material as needed by contractor or maintenance.
Daily coordination of construction activities with contractors, vendors, HON operations, E/I, and maintenance.
Daily Inspections of the construction underway.  Daily Inspections of the Contractors’ Documentation and PPE:  i.e. work permits, JSAs, HASPs/AHAs.  Performing CSAs on a routine basis.
Daily Inspections of the Contractors’ Work Areas.
First line QA/QC, coordinating with plant or external resources as needed.  Witness tests (grounding, continuity, megger) sign docs, forward to PMs.
Gather daily construction reports from contractor and or maintenance include info on weather, crew make-up, and daily major achievements (see “Daily Construction Log”).
Coordinate project tie-in work with the plant.
Report weekly highlights to the project engineer including digital field pictures when appropriate.
Receive and sign QA/QC Turn-Over Checklists prior to PSSRs.
Under direction of the project manager, lead the final field activities required to close a project i.e. any construction related changes or punch list items.
Obtain Job Completion documentation from Contractors, including As-Builts which are forwarded to the PM.
SAFETY & ENVIRONMENTAL
Assure all work meets safety and environmental regulations and procedures; facilitate “Life Critical” permits for contractors assuring proper notification and signatures of proper plant personnel. (LOTO, Hot Work, Line Break, Confined Space, and Critical Lifts).
Verify that contractors are trained on any site specific procedures i.e., Fall Protection and Scaffolding Awareness.
Report monthly manpower numbers (individual projects to the various PMs and totals to the designated Project Control Tech) for the calculation of safety incident rates.
Confirm on-site construction personnel meet the site/Company security and safety requirements.
Witness and document contractor toolbox safety meetings.
Participate in incident reviews involving contractors.
Report Incidents to Capital Leader and the Project Engineer/Manager.
SCHEDULE
Drive construction schedules and deliverables.  Do not take a passive role. Coordinate independent contractor schedule milestones to maintain the overall project schedule.
Report schedule deviations to the Project Manager.
Identify & recommend overall Construction workload adjustments when appropriate.
Present to PMs, any conflicts or opportunities, regarding safety, cost, schedule, constructability, operability, maintainability.
COST CONTROL
Do the initial review of contractors’ invoices and estimate percent complete verses percent billed. Pass on to project engineer for receiving in SAP.
COMMISIONING & START-UP
Manage the field redlined as-built drawings and pass to project engineer.
Lead loop check activities.
Participate in PSSR.
Complete PSSR punch list pertaining to construction.
Participate in Contractor Performance Rating for each of the major contractors as needed.
Participate in the project critique.

Technical/Industry Experience and Qualifications Requirements:
Experience varies based on education background. Those with degree typically have 10+ years relevant experience. Those with trade qualifications will typically have 12+ years relevant experience.
Seasoned ability to inform and persuade on complex matters comes from recognition as subject matter expert. Utilized on the most complex and difficult problems.
Advanced understanding of systems, processes and tools related to field. Able to assist others and troubleshoot issues.

Required:
University Degree, or equivalent, in related field or an equivalent trade qualification combined with further relevant training and experience.

title: Material Controller I
description:
Building on our past. Ready for the future
Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts. We partner with customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their assets. We’re bridging two worlds, moving towards more sustainable energy sources, while helping to provide the energy, chemicals and resources needed now.
Material Controller
Play an integral role in delivering projects that matter. At Worley, materials are more than inventory—they are the backbone of safe, efficient, and sustainable project execution. As a Material Controller, you join a collaborative project environment where planning, precision, and partnership come together to support construction and installation activities that drive real-world impact. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, procurement, and construction, and is ideal for someone who takes pride in keeping complex projects moving forward through disciplined materials management.
Purpose of the role
You will be responsible for ensuring the efficient receipt, storage, control, and distribution of materials and equipment on site. The role focuses on maintaining a robust materials control system that aligns engineering requirements with construction schedules, while supporting Worley’s commitment to sustainability, safety, and operational excellence. Your work ensures that materials are available when needed, waste is minimized, and projects are positioned for successful execution.
Core Responsibilities
Review engineering drawings, blueprints, and product specifications to accurately determine material requirements and confirm alignment with project scope and sustainability objectives.
Maintain and operate a comprehensive materials control and inventory management system, tracking materials from receipt through final issue.
Coordinate closely with engineering, procurement, construction, and site teams to ensure materials are available at the right time and location.
Process material requisitions and orders, verifying specifications, codes, quantities, and approved vendors or brands.
Monitor material usage and inventory levels, adjusting forecasts and orders to reflect project changes or existing stock.
Identify potential material shortages, surpluses, or risks and develop practical, proactive mitigation plans.
Ensure materials handling, storage, and distribution activities comply with safety, quality, and project standards.
Leverage digital tools, ERP systems, and reporting processes to improve accuracy, visibility, and efficiency in materials management.
Provide guidance and technical support to team members involved in material control activities.
Communicate clearly and professionally with contractors, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to resolve issues and maintain seamless material flow.
