title: Technician – Maintenance Level 2 CMC (Rotational Schedule) - Prudhoe Bay, AK
description:
This is a remote/ rotational position, working a rotational schedule (two weeks on/ two weeks off or three weeks on / three weeks off), in Prudhoe Bay, AK. The typical schedule is 84 hours per week (40 hours straight time and a minimum of 44 hours at time and a half). All meals and lodging are provided by Worley while the employee is on location. Transportation between Anchorage and Prudhoe Bay is provided.
Worley offers a competitive benefits package, with company paid short-term disability, life insurance, paid sick leave, and 4.5% employer match on 401k.
Purpose
:
The Technician – Maintenance Level 2 CMC performs craft level support duties including various manual, un-skilled, and/or skilled tasks as required for mechanical piping, structural installation, pipe lifting, scaffold erection, sheet metal fabrication, pipe line insulation and rigging, in accordance with all Hilcorp and Worley safety, environmental and operational practices, policies and procedures.
Essential Job Functions:
·
Perform piping spool/valve installation and removal, rigging, blinding and minor pipe fitting.
·
Perform manual labor including operating small hand tools and power tools. (buffer/grinders, reciprocating saws, drills, shovels, etc.), and carrying and lifting materials (cribbing, shoveling snow, and other activities).
·
Perform heavy labor.
·
Assist building scaffold with qualified scaffold builder.
·
Performs manual labor supporting scaffolding activity, such as cleanup, hauling, stacking materials, shoveling, stacking pipe skids, moving supports, handling steel material and valves.
·
Demonstrate and promote safe work practices and adhere to company and client safety policies and procedures for work performed, including proper hazard recognition and mitigation of task and accept accountability for safe work practices.
·
Demonstrate support for the company’s environmental management system.
·
Ability to work as a part of a team and follow work direction.
·
Participate in JSA, pre-job walk-down and risk assessment.
·
Routinely perform safety and productivity observations; shop, field, and vehicle inspections.
·
Routinely operate Worley/client light and/or medium duty vehicles
·
Safely climb ladders of various heights.
Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:
·
General knowledge of structural and mechanical piping maintenance operations.
·
General knowledge of rigging and bolt-up procedures.
·
Ability to help with piping spool installation and removal.
·
Ability to work with minimal supervision and be capable of performing assigned tasks. with limited general technical guidance.
·
General mathematical knowledge.
·
Depending on assignment, may be required to prepare and process various types of documentation including permits and risk assessments to identify task hazards.
·
Must be self-motivated and work well with others.
·
Ability to follow all policies and procedures and work in a safe and productive manner.
·
Capable of learning various Worley, and Hilcorp safety and operational procedures and demonstrating required competencies.
·
Able to effectively communicate with fellow workers and alternate.
·
Advanced knowledge of all of the following: mechanical piping, structural and scaffold disciplines including bolt-up, rigging, pipefitting/installation.
·
Advanced ability to interpret mechanical drawings & P&ID.
·
Ability to operate vehicles (Pickups, 12 foot flatbed trucks - F-550, 12 foot box van trucks – F-550) and equipment (i.e. Man lifts) in all season adverse weather or road conditions.
·
Able to work in confined spaces and wear respirators.
·
Basic hand power/took knowledge.
·
Ability to interpret work instructions.
·
Basic knowledge of piping insulation.
·
Provides work leadership to lower-level General Maintenance Techs.
Physical Demand/Work Environment:
Work is performed in a remote Arctic environment with limited medical resources. Candidate understands the site is approximately 840 miles (at least 4 hours by air ambulance) from surgical, specialist, and tertiary medical care, and where medical evacuation from this location may be significantly delayed due to weather conditions. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the essential functions of this job, the employee is required to:
·
Must have ability to stand, walk on level, uneven and slippery surfaces, sit, squat, kneel, crawl, reach through low and high ranges, work overhead, and exhibit normal balance and coordination. These basic physical requirements are essential for safe performance of the job in harsh environments with exposure to very cold temperatures and while wearing arctic gear.
·
Standing for prolonged periods of time.
·
Driving for prolonged periods of time in the dark and inclement weather
·
Ability to climb scaffold, ramps, stairs, equipment, portable ladders, and/or wellhouse/tank/facility fixed ladders of 20 feet or greater.
·
Ability to wear and utilize fall protection within manufacturer specifications.
·
Lift 50 lbs. from floor to waist with two hands.
·
Lift 50 lbs. from floor to shoulder with two hands.
·
Carry 50 lbs. for 15 feet with two hands.
·
Push/pull 60 lbs. sled for 20 feet.
·
Push/pull 90 lbs. cart for 20 feet.
This job description is intended to describe the nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this position. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities and duties required of the job incumbents.
Worley
provides reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities, including both applicants and employees, to allow the individual to perform the essential functions of the job, unless doing so would create an undue hardship.
In-Vehicle Monitoring System
: As part of our commitment to safety and accountability, company vehicles are equipped with in-cab cameras and vehicle monitoring systems. These systems may record video and audio, as well as collect GPS location, vehicle speed, harsh braking, rapid acceleration and other driving behaviors. All data is subject to review by management to ensure compliance with company policies and safe driving practices.
Required Qualifications:
One (1) years’ experience working in one or more of the following disciplines:
mechanical piping/bolt up, structural steel install, scaffold building, rigging, equipment operator, sheet metal work, insulation.
Completion of scaffold inspection competent person training within 90 days of hire.
Valid driver’s and the ability to be covered by Worley's auto insurer.
High School diploma or equivalent (GED).
North Slope Training Cooperative (NSTC). Worley can provide NSTC certification training if needed.
Preferred Qualifications:
Petrochemical, oilfield, or arctic experience.
Two (2) years of mechanical piping/bolt up.
Rigging qualification.
Two (2) years of one of the following - mechanical piping/bolt up, structural steel install, scaffold building, rigging, equipment operator, sheet metal work, insulation.

title: Director, Supply Chain
description:
We deliver the world’s most complex projects
Work as part of a collaborative and inclusive team
Enjoy a varied & challenging role
Building on our past. Ready for the future
Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia.
Right now, we’re bridging two worlds as we accelerate to more sustainable energy sources, while helping our customers provide the energy, chemicals and resources that society needs now.
We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their portfolio of assets. We solve complex problems by finding integrated data-centric solutions from the first stages of consulting and engineering to installation and commissioning, to the last stages of decommissioning and remediation. Join us and help drive innovation and sustainability in our projects.
The Role
As a Director with Worley,
you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
This role exists to drive strategic alignment, cultural transformation, and organizational excellence for delivering our Projects. It plays a critical part in cultivating commitment to change—especially when bold shifts are needed to realize Worley’s vision. By setting clear goals and ensuring synergy between people, processes, and tools, the role enables flawless execution of Projects. It also focuses on building a competitively superior organization by attracting, developing, and retaining top talent—ensuring the right people are in the right roles at the right time to meet evolving business needs.
This full-time regional role that supports the India/GID region and offers flexibility to be based anywhere within the region. The candidate will be a leader with at least twenty years of EPC - full project delivery experience. She/He must possess a robust background in capital project procurement, subcontracts, logistics, expediting, supplier inspection, and materials management.
Key Accountabilities:-
Foster a participative management style with a cooperative team approach, promoting a collaborative and high-performing work environment that supports Worley’s commitment to innovation and sustainability.
Assimilate information from multiple sources to derive answers and solve questions, leveraging deep expertise and past experiences to support Worley’s promise of being a straightforward partner in sustainable transformation.
Directs the development of all regional supply chain activities, both strategic and operational.
Ownership of the full regional end-to-end supply chain.
Evaluates risk and creates supply chain risk mitigation strategies.
Aggregating regional demand, and proactively collaborating with the global team to maximize sourcing economies of scale.
Making sure that vendor and subcontractor performance meets contractual requirements by managing supplier relationships.
Planning and executing successful workshare scopes through the Worley Global Integrated Delivery (GID) location(s).
Ensuring the regional operations are working in alignment with the global supply chain strategies.
Delivers measurable supply chain performance metrics to the business.
Providing subject matter expertise to support supply chain contractual disputes.
Monitor and manage annual goals and objectives associated with cost, quality, schedule, competitiveness, safety, and compliance.
Ensuring that Worley standards for processes, tools, and systems are correctly utilized.
Behavioral Details:-
At Worley, how we work matters as much as what we achieve. This position will play an important role in fostering a culture of ownership, inclusion, and growth through our values & behaviors we live every day.
Embrace Future Thinking – Anticipates trends and prepares for what’s next. Encourages innovation and forward-looking solutions.
Inspire Ownership
– Takes initiative and follows through with accountability. Empowers others to act with autonomy and purpose.
Make Connections
– Builds strong, authentic relationships across teams and functions. Collaborates effectively to drive shared success.
Be Curious – Seeks to understand before being understood. Continuously learns and explores new ideas and perspectives.
Stand for Inclusion
– Champions diversity and equity in all interactions. Creates space for every voice to be heard and valued.
Coach to Unlock Potential – Supports others through feedback, mentoring, and development. Encourages growth by recognizing strengths and opportunities.
Make Purposeful Decisions – Balances short-term needs with long-term impact. Uses data, insight, and values to guide choices.
Create Trusted Space to Challenge – Fosters psychological safety for open dialogue and constructive dissent. Welcomes different viewpoints to strengthen outcomes.
Be Resourceful & Resilient – Navigates ambiguity and adapts to change with confidence. Finds creative solutions and maintains momentum under pressure.
Leadership Attributes & Mindsets :-
Calm and Optimistic Under Pressure
– Maintains composure and positivity in challenging situations.
Courageous & Growth-Oriented
– Openly discusses challenges and mistakes, embraces continuous learning, and constructively challenges the status quo.
Curious & Self-Reflective – Seeks feedback, remains open to new ideas, and reflects on personal growth and impact.
Person-Centered Leadership
– Leads with empathy, values collaboration, and prioritizes people in decision-making.
Authentic & Trustworthy – Demonstrates integrity, transparency, and consistency in words and actions.
Accountable & Ownership-Driven

title: Senior Cost Analyst
description:
Build the future of cost excellence. Shape what’s next with Worley.
At Worley, we’re delivering a more sustainable world. As a
Senior Cost Analyst
, you’ll play a key role in supporting project success by providing accurate, insightful and strategic cost control across large, complex initiatives. Your work will help customers deliver the resources society needs today while transitioning toward a cleaner, more sustainable future.
Purpose of the role
In this role, you’ll coordinate cost analysis activities for one or more major projects—ensuring the quality, accuracy and clarity of all cost reporting. You’ll serve as a key advisor to project management and stakeholders, guiding decisions with data‑driven insights and maintaining strong alignment across teams. Through leadership, collaboration and technical expertise, you’ll help us deliver projects efficiently, responsibly and with purpose.
Core responsibilities
Coordinate overall cost analysis activities across one or more large, complex projects.
Ensure the preparation, accuracy and quality of project cost reports and forecasts.
Establish strong communication channels with project management and customers on all matters related to cost control.
Conduct periodic site visits to validate field cost reporting and project progress.
Assign, review and support the work of cost analysis team members as a senior advisor.
Lead functional project teams and participate in cross‑functional collaboration when required.
Provide informed technical guidance and support to others on cost systems, processes and tools.
Prepare and deliver proposals, presentations and reports, informing and persuading stakeholders on complex cost‑related matters.
Work with broad objectives and priorities, influencing outcomes across multiple teams and disciplines.
Apply sound judgment to ensure compliance with standards, policies and best practices.
Skills & experience
Bachelor’s degree in a related discipline or equivalent professional experience.
Typically
7+ years of relevant experience
in cost analysis, cost control or project controls.
Advanced understanding of cost management systems, processes and tools.
Ability to troubleshoot issues, support others and provide technical guidance.
Strong analytical, organizational and communication skills.
Experience leading small teams or providing senior‑level technical support.
Ability to prepare and deliver high‑quality proposals, reports and presentations.
Strong stakeholder engagement and collaboration capabilities.
Experience in the mining industry is a strong plus.
Ability to work effectively in dynamic, multidisciplinary project environments.
If you need any accessibility adjustments, please include this information in your application so we can support you.
Benefits
Feel the energy at Worley with access to:
Global learning and development opportunities.
A values‑driven culture that promotes wellbeing, inclusion and purpose.

title: Material Controller
description:
Worley Canada Construction is a leader in industrial construction in Alberta and western Canada. Our employees enjoy exciting careers in fabrication, modularization, field installation, and professional support services for some of world's most challenging heavy-oil facilities, gas plants, power-stations, renewable energy, and other industrial projects. As part of the global Worley team, we enjoy shared resources and opportunities with more than 20 Canadian locations and 40 countries.
Worley Canada Construction is looking for a
Materials Controller
for our growing Materials Management team to work on a field site in
Alberta  and/or Saskatchewan
.
Work Conditions:
•
This role is based at site near Squamish, British Columbia.
•
Living out Allowance, and Travel Allowance applicable for those not local to the area
•
10/4 shift rotation
•
Must have a driver’s licence and a reliable means of transportation.
Material Handling
·
Prepare timely and accurate Bills of Lading and associated shipping documents.
·
Monitor, schedule, coordinate and communicate deliveries to and from the site.
·
Communicate with suppliers, drivers, and site supervision to ensure timely deliveries.
·
Support Material Handlers with escorting loads, conducting physical inspections of material, and laydown management, as required.
Material Receiving
·
Engages and supports the field-level materials team and prioritizes ensuring they can successfully receive incoming materials and resolve issues.
·
Enables timely physical material receipt through processing of preliminary MRRs and posting of completed receipts.
·
Works with our clients to schedule shipments of free issued materials.
·
Receives and maintains inventory within Worley’s Material Management software, processing material receipts and issue tickets.
·
Troubleshoots receiving issues, generates and resolves OS&Ds, and interfaces with buyers, suppliers, and clients to do so.
·
Attests invoices requiring further investigation and resolution using Imageconnect system.
·
Registers heat and serial numbers and attaches corresponding documentation (MTRs, CRNs, etc.) to material records.
·
Coordinates with Home Office support to ensure all remotely supported procurement and materials management activities are being completed in a timely fashion.
Construction Readiness
·
Works closely with the Materials Planner to actively understand materials forecast data to drive closeout of material deficiencies preventing completion of work packages.
·
Coordinates with construction to understand fabrication / assembly priorities and prioritizes material picking / receiving activities associated with those.
·
Constantly communicates with construction to understand any changes or resequencing of priorities.
·
Other materials management activities as assigned by site or functional management.
Materials management is a dynamic function, with changing priorities and different challenges encountered from project to project.
The successful candidate will rely on both experience and judgement to plan and accomplish goals.
They may display some or all the following qualities:
·
Team Player
: Understands that we only succeed when we operate as a successful team, not individuals, and actively works with others to troubleshoot issues, generate solutions, and share knowledge.
·
Cross-functional Collaborator
: Leans on their experience with other disciplines to understand how their work can reduce duplication of effort and support other project team members.
·
Critical Thinker
: Analyses information from various sources, evaluates data, questions assumptions, and makes informed decisions by considering multiple perspectives to solve complex problems and develop effective strategies.
·
Strong Communicator:
Has the ability to communicate detailed ideas and concepts clearly and effectively to various stakeholders with differing levels of understanding.
·
Understands Agile Prioritization:
Maximises productivity and efficiency by continual evaluation of priorities and adjusting outstanding tasks to ensure the most valuable assignments are completed first.
Qualifications
Completion of post-secondary education or trades certification is required.
The ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, particularly piping isometrics, is considered an asset.
A minimum of 5 years experience in Industrial construction is required.
Knowledge of the fabrication / modularization / field assembly process is considered an asset.
Practical knowledge of pipe, valves, fittings, instrumentation, equipment, and electrical materials and the associated material grades, codes and standards is strongly preferred.
MS Excel Experience – knowledge of advanced Excel functions and Power Apps is considered an asset.
Extensive knowledge of and confident user of Material Management and Procurement systems (Aveva Enterprise Resource Management Systems or equivalent SAP, JD Edwards, Site Sense etc.)
Worley strives to be an industry leader in health, safety, and environmental performance.
Our vision is to achieve zero harm to people and assets, and zero environmental incidents.
We select people who share our values, beliefs, and commitment to this vision and who demonstrate the expected behaviors, competencies and performance associated with their perspective roles with the company.
Attention Staffing & Recruitment Agencies:
Worley Canada Construction
will not pay fees for recruitment activities related to the hiring or placement of a candidate unless a written service agreement has been established and executed between a duly authorized representative of
Worley Canada Construction
and the recruitment/placement firm. In addition, in order to qualify for recruitment fees, all candidate resumes must be submitted to
Worley Canada Construction
through our Human Resources Recruitment department. Resumes sent to our individual department heads without the express written approval of the recruitment department will be ineligible for a fee.

The Candidate will conduct a comprehensive review of the Work Requests (WRs), Work Orders (WOs), and the layup plan to identify any discrepancies or gaps between the WOs and the layup plan. Draft Layup Plan will be provided as shown in Section (A3).
The Candidate will use ROOMS to locate all WO/WR related to the layup plan.
The Candidate will identify all WOs that are not set to approved.

Responsibilities
:
The Candidate will review WOs to confirm that necessary holds are properly established.
In cases where holds are missing, the contractor will communicate with OPG to ensure that appropriate holds are placed where required.
To support the assessment process and facilitate the clearance of holds, the Candidate will provide marked-up flowsheets for use by the assessors.
Prior to preparing any draft instructions related to an Order To Operate (OTO), the contractor will submit a list of recommended OTOs to OPG for review. This step is intended to prevent potential overlap with engineering holds, which are managed separately by the OPG Engineering team.
If an OTO is recommended, the contractor will then prepare a draft set of instructions that assessors can use to create the OTO.
Similarly, before finalizing a Technical Procedure Action Request (TPAR), the Candidate will provide the documentation, including detailed markups to OPG for review.
This is to identify any potential overlap with engineering holds. If a TPAR is recommended, the contractor will then initiate and submit the TPAR.
Recommendations should be fit for purpose, cost-effective, and time-efficient.

List of recommended WO/WR to be initiated by OPG - based on the gaps identified in item (1) above.
List of the presence and adequacy of holds, including identification of any missing holds.

Identify where OTO will be sufficient to execute the work.
Identify where TPAR will be required to execute the work.

description:

Objetivo del cargo:
Proporciona dirección y gestión de proyectos relacionados con la construcción para garantizar la finalización dentro del plazo programado, cumpliendo o por debajo del presupuesto y de acuerdo con las obligaciones contractuales. Planifica y define los objetivos del programa, y diseña métodos para alcanzarlos; desarrolla un conocimiento profundo de los objetivos del cliente, los términos contractuales y las políticas corporativas.
Principales Responsabilidades:
Toma de Decisiones
Capacidad para resolver problemas y desarrollar planes tácticos para implementar metas organizacionales, así como supervisar el diseño de nuevos conceptos e ideas relacionados con proyectos y su área funcional de experiencia; amplio conocimiento del área funcional y habilidad para implementar y liderar el cambio organizacional en proyectos de manera efectiva; las soluciones se derivan de información general interpretada y aplicada, y de consultas con otras personas.
Supervisión Recibida
Trabaja con interacción autoiniciada con su supervisor y orientación técnica autoiniciada. Tiene influencia sobre sus responsabilidades. Recibe dirección administrativa basada en políticas y objetivos del proyecto y la organización. El trabajo se revisa para asegurar la conformidad con las directrices del proyecto, las políticas y la coordinación con otros departamentos de la empresa.
Autoridad de Supervisión
Tiene informes directos y puede tener informes indirectos, con autoridad para evaluaciones de desempeño que impactan la remuneración. Toma decisiones sobre la selección, capacitación, disciplina y remuneración del personal. Asigna trabajos del programa que involucran varios proyectos y establece el marco de políticas para el trabajo en proyectos.
Comunicación
Comunica y presenta de manera efectiva propuestas y reportes complejos a la alta dirección. Capacidad para persuadir e influenciar a otros. Estilo de gestión participativo con un enfoque de equipo cooperativo.
Sistemas, Procesos y Herramientas
Comprensión avanzada de sistemas, procesos y herramientas relacionadas con el área. Capaz de asistir a otros y solucionar problemas. Puede estar involucrado en el desarrollo de nuevos sistemas, procesos y herramientas.
¿Qué traerás?
Software, procesos y herramientas:
-
Título de Ingeniero Civil.
-
15+ años de experiencia relevante
-
Experiencia como Gerente de Construcción en compañías de EPC/EPCM.
-
Experiencia en proyectos grandes mineros (Sobre 1 B de USD)
En caso de que necesites algún
ajuste de accesibilidad
por favor no dejes de aclararlo en tu postulación.

Estamos comprometidos a construir un lugar de trabajo diverso, inclusivo y respetuoso donde todos sientan que pertenecen, puedan hablar y ser escuchados. Brindamos igualdad de oportunidades de empleo a todos los solicitantes y empleados calificados sin importar edad, raza, credo, color, religión, sexo, origen nacional, ascendencia, estado de discapacidad, estado de veterano, orientación sexual, identidad o expresión de género, información genética, estado civil. estatus, estatus de ciudadanía o cualquier otra base protegida por la ley.
Queremos que nuestra gente esté llena de energía y poder para impulsar un impacto sostenible. Por eso, nos centramos en una cultura inspirada en valores que genere brillantez a través de la pertenencia, la conexión y la innovación.
Estamos construyendo un lugar de trabajo diverso, inclusivo y respetuoso. Crear un espacio donde todos sientan que pertenecen, puedan ser ellos mismos y ser escuchados.

description:

Worley Consulting Group
Americas

.

Network Specialist
shall be to serve as a Subject Matter Expert for the design and implementation of secure, reliable and high-performance data networks for industrial environments across Oil & Gas, Mining, Power, and Chemical sectors. The successful candidate will consult for our clients and guide/lead the network design across all project phases from high level conceptual design to implementation. The role focuses on enabling safe, resilient and scalable solutions to support automation, digitalization, IIoT and autonomous operations.

Pre-FEED / FEED and Detailed Design:
·
Develop High-Level and Low-Level Design packages for industrial networks
·
Define network segmentation strategies in alignment with cybersecurity best practices
·
Prepare design criteria and network philosophies.
·
Design private LTE/5G, Wi-Fi and other wireless data networks for industrial applications
·
Support IioT, edge computing and data acquisition architectures analytics, digital twin and automation systems.
·
Define bandwidth requirements, redundancy models and availability targets.
·
Develop network asset inventory and perform cybersecurity assessments.
·
Develop FEED reports, network equipment specifications, and MTOs.

Produce network topology diagrams, system architectures, IP addressing schemes, VLAN plans and firewall rulesets

Provide input to fiber optic network design, cabinet layouts and termination diagrams

Participate in Risk Assessments.

Prepare technical specifications, datasheets and material requisitions for network equipment.

Prepare FAT and SAT procedures

Support network configuration, validation and system integration testing.
·
Assist commissioning teams with network readiness, connectivity testing and performance verifiction.
·
Support troubleshooting, performance optimization, system cutover and transition to operations
Cybersecurity and Network Resilience:
·
Design and implement industrial cybersecurity controls align with IEC 62443, NIST, and industry best practices
·
Define firewall architectures, access control policies, remote access solutions and monitoring requirements.
·
Support risk assessments, and cybersecurity design reviews.
·
Support secure integration of OT systems with enterprise IT environments and cloud platforms.

·
Leverages and helps develop the diverse background and skills of people for the attainment of company goals.

Plans and executes projects through teamwork with other departments and with outside organizations.

Identifies gaps and builds an environment which has readily accessible knowledge and continuous learning.

Identify opportunities for technology optimization, standardization and cost improvements.

Contribute to client presentations and demonstrations

Experience delivering industrial network solutions in Oil & Gas, Mining, Power, Chemical, or similar industrial environments.
Strong understanding of IT/OT convergence and industrial network architectures.
Experience in the design and implementation of Wi-Fi, Private LTE/5G networks for industrial facilities.
Practical experience in network design for buildings and industrial facilities including data centers, inside and outside plant (OSP).
Experience in the implementation of cybersecurity planning and implementation within industrial facilities.
Experience in various industrial networks including Ethernet, Ethernet IP, Profibus, etc.
Exposure to IIoT, edge computing, and data integration platforms.
Experience with industrial cybersecurity frameworks and standards (IEC 62443, NIST, ISO 27001).
Familiarity with EPC/EPCM project delivery environments.
Experience supporting conceptual, FEED, and detailed engineering phases.
Experience with vendor selection, system integration, and testing activities (FAT/SAT).

Fluent in English (read, write, and speak).

Strong leadership and mentoring abilities
·
Excellent communication skills (written and verbal).

Strong organizational and time-management skills.
·
Ability to work collaboratively with multi-discipline teams.
·
Proactive, detail-oriented and committed to high-quality work.

Cybersecurity Certifications such as ISA/IEC 62443, ISC2 CC or others considered an asset

Certifications from industry leaders such as Cisco, Juniper, Nokia, HP, etc. considered an asset

Por lo general, tener más de 12 años de experiencia en disciplinas relevantes y más de 3 años en liderazgo de proyectos en el área de dibujo y modelamiento.
Debe tener una sólida formación en el trabajo disciplinario y comprensión competente de códigos, estándares y buenas prácticas de la industria, y debe ser capaz de gestionar procesos de configuración de la disciplina, la institución de procedimientos de trabajo, el seguimiento de un equipo, la producción de entregables y el cierre de proyectos.
Debe estar en capacidad de apoyar la labor de estimación de generación de ofertas de proyectos y redacción de contenidos de propuestas técnicas en alcances de dibujo y modelamiento.
Tener experiencia en la realización de labores de dibujo y modelamiento en ingenierías conceptuales, básicas y detalladas de proyectos de la industria (Oil & Gas, Minería, Infraestructura, entre otros).

ejercer un juicio independiente en la planificación, organización y realización de las asignaciones, hacer recomendaciones generales sobre la utilización de nuevas técnicas de dibujo y modelamiento, normalmente dentro de un área de especialización, y analizar los elementos de diseño en busca de tendencias potenciales, viabilidad técnica, requisitos del cliente o contractuales.

description:

Represent Worley Consulting at industry forums (e.g., PEI, ACG New York, Energy Capital Conferences).

Embed Worley’s zero‑harm vision; align client solutions with net‑zero and sustainability goals.

Experience
15+ years in Financial Advisory with expertise in M&A advisory, debt financing advisory, LTA, or ESG financing.

title: Wells Interventions Roustabout (Rotational Schedule) - Prudhoe Bay, AK
description:
This is a remote/ rotational position, working two weeks on and two weeks off or three weeks on and three weeks off, in Prudhoe Bay, AK. The typical schedule is 84 hours per week (40 hours straight time and a minimum of 44 hours at time and a half). All meals and lodging are provided by Worley while the employee is on location. Transportation between Anchorage and Prudhoe Bay is provided.
Worley offers a competitive benefits package, with company paid short-term disability, life insurance, paid sick leave, and 4.5% employer match on 401k.
Job Purpose:
Working under the supervision of the Wells Intervention Lead, the Wells Intervention Roustabout performs day to day manual labor and maintenance on equipment and facilities for the Wells Intervention Team.
Essential Job Functions:
·
Attend various technical, developmental and safety training.
·
Demonstrate adherence to established safety policies and procedures.
·
Demonstrate support for the company’s HSE management system.
·
Perform manual labor including clean up and stick picking.
·
Perform heavy labor such as layout of hardline pipe and hauling/stacking materials on trailers or skids.
·
Operate Wells service equipment: Loaders, Rig Trucks, Forklifts, Man-lifts, Boom Trucks, Lowboys.
·
Perform hydro-testing on hard line or wellheads.
·
Set up Wells Support jobs including Coil jobs, E-Line jobs, Full bore Jobs, Tree replacements, Well Disconnect and Reconnect with various flow-back components and pressure equipment.
·
Perform rigging load calculations and proper rigging for lifting operations.
·
Safely climb ladders of various heights.
Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:
·
Able to identify flanges.
·
Knowledge of hardline components and uses.
·
Knowledge of hydro testing.
·
Knowledge of rigging procedures.
·
Demonstrated experience with wellhead components, bolt-up procedures, flanges, threaded pipe and fittings, and proper safe use of tools.
·
Must be a self-starter; able to work independently with minimal supervision.
·
Ability to work as a part of a team and follow work directions.
·
Able to effectively communicate with fellow workers and alternate.
·
Capable of learning various Worley and client safety and operational procedures and demonstrating required competencies.
·
Sound knowledge of operations and safety policies and procedures.
Physical Demand/Work Environment:
Work is performed in a remote Arctic environment with limited medical resources. Candidate understands the site is approximately 840 miles (at least 4 hours by air ambulance) from surgical, specialist, and tertiary medical care, and where medical evacuation from this location may be significantly delayed due to weather conditions. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the essential functions of this job, the employee is required to:
·
Must have ability to stand, walk on level, uneven and slippery surfaces, sit, squat, kneel, crawl, reach through low and high ranges, work overhead, and exhibit normal balance and coordination. These basic physical requirements are essential for safe performance of the job in harsh environments with exposure to very cold temperatures and while wearing arctic gear.
·
Standing for prolonged periods of time.
·
Driving for prolonged periods of time in the dark and inclement weather
·
Ability to climb scaffold, ramps, stairs, equipment, portable ladders, and/or wellhouse/tank/facility fixed ladders of 20 feet or greater.
·
Ability to wear and utilize fall protection within manufacturer specifications.
·
Lift 50 lbs. from floor to waist with two hands.
·
Lift 50 lbs. from floor to shoulder with two hands.
·
Carry 50 lbs. for 15 feet with two hands.
·
Push/pull 60 lbs. sled for 20 feet.
·
Push/pull 90 lbs. cart for 20 feet.
This job description is intended to describe the nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this position. It is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities and duties required of the job incumbents.  Worley provides reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities, including both applicants and employees, to allow the individual to perform the essential functions of the job, unless doing so would create an undue hardship.
In-Vehicle Monitoring System
: As part of our commitment to safety and accountability, company vehicles are equipped with in-cab cameras and vehicle monitoring systems. These systems may record video and audio, as well as collect GPS location, vehicle speed, harsh braking, rapid acceleration and other driving behaviors. Basic Qualifications:

Obtain a valid Class A CDL with tanker and hazmat endorsement within six months from date of hire.

Valid driver’s license and the ability to be insured by Worley auto insurer.
·
High school diploma or equivalent GED.
·
North Slope Training Cooperative (NSTC). Worley can provide NSTC certification training if needed.

One (1) year experience with flange identification, triplex pump, bolt-up, or basic rigging procedures.

One (1) year experience in petrochemical environment.

One (1) year experience working in a Wells Intervention environment.

Nos asociamos con clientes para entregar proyectos y crear valor durante la vida útil de sus activos. Objetivo:
Responsabilizarse por la realización y asignación de trabajos de ingeniería complejos o con alto nivel de dificultad, debido a su capacidad, conocimiento avanzado, especialización y experiencia en el dominio de una o múltiples áreas de la ingeniería y de su disciplina en particular, además de otro tipo de productos y sistemas.  Con habilidad y capacidad de liderazgo para dirigir pequeños grupos en proyectos o equipos de trabajo.
Responsabilidades:
Por lo general, tener más de 10 años de experiencia relevante en la disciplina y un conocimiento y comprensión competente de las regulaciones, códigos, estándares de diseño y fabricación, y prácticas estándar de la industria.  Adicionalmente debe tener conocimientos sólidos en la estimación de los costos de un proyecto y la redacción de contenidos de propuestas.
Tener experiencia en la realización de ingenierías conceptuales, básicas y detalladas de proyectos de la industria (Oil & Gas, Minería, Infraestructura, entre otros).
Tomar decisiones responsables para la definición del curso de entregables de ingeniería, dibujo y modelamiento.  Las decisiones difíciles, complejas o inusuales se remitirán al Gerente de Ingeniería o al Gerente de la disciplina locales.
Trabajar de forma autónoma permitiendo la planificación y organización de tareas en proyectos asignados, propias y de los integrantes de su equipo, en caso de dirigir uno.
Realizar sus funciones con base en una interacción y orientación técnica autoiniciada con el supervisor (gerente de la disciplina), para posteriormente influenciar sobre los objetivos y deberes de su equipo.
Recibir, gestionar y llevar a cabo asignaciones relacionadas con proyectos de ingeniería con objetivos y prioridades específicas, considerando las áreas críticas que pueden afectar el trabajo de otras unidades. Trabajar en equipos de hasta 10 personas que le reportan directamente, ya sea participando o liderando, y que pueden estar conformados por ingenieros y diseñadores de la misma disciplina, pero podrían incluir un tamaño total mucho mayor que considere un apoyo coordinado. Profesional en Ingeniería Eléctrica.

description:
We deliver the world’s most complex projects.
Work as part of a collaborative and inclusive team .

Building on our past. Ready for the future
Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia.
Right now, we’re bridging two worlds as we accelerate to more sustainable energy sources, while helping our customers provide the energy, chemicals and resources that society needs now.

Join us and help drive innovation and sustainability in our projects.
The Role
As a Cost Analyst I with Worley
, you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
The Concept Cost Estimator will join the Worley Consulting team to provide cost estimating and project economics support across the Power, Renewables, Low Carbon, Oil & Gas, Chemicals, and Refining sectors throughout the APAC region.
This role focuses on the delivery of high-quality cost estimates, benchmarking analyses, and economic assessments to support feasibility studies, project development, and investment decision-making for clients. The successful candidate having ~2-5 years of experience will combine strong estimating capability with commercial insight and consulting acumen to deliver practical, data-driven recommendations that enhance project value and confidence.
Develop and deliver conceptual and feasibility cost estimates for projects across the energy and chemicals value chain. At this early phase, estimates are based on minimal project definition. Typical concept estimating methods include; capacity factored, equipment factored, analogous and parametric models.
Provide cost input and advice throughout project development phases — from early concept through to execution.
Prepare and review cost basis, methodologies, and estimating assumptions consistent with project scope and maturity.
Perform benchmarking, cost trending, and sensitivity analyses to support project decision-making.
Interface with project controls, engineering, procurement, and construction teams to validate cost data and align estimates with current market conditions.
Support the development of cost databases, norms, and regional escalation indices.
Prepare high-quality estimating reports, presentations, and recommendations for clients.
Assist in the development of estimating methodologies, tools, and procedures within Worley Consulting.
Contribute to proposal development, project scoping, and business case preparation for consulting engagements.
Provide estimating input to multidisciplinary studies, including techno-economic evaluations, due diligence, and project risk assessments.
About You
To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
Comfortable working in the concept and feasibility phase of project development with minimal project and estimate definition
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline. Preference for Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering.
Excellent analytical, numerical, and problem-solving skills.
Strong written and verbal communication and report-writing skills with the ability to present findings to clients.
Ability to work effectively in multi-disciplinary teams across different locations and time zones.
Relevant experience in the Power, Oil & Gas, Chemicals, or Refining industries.
Experience preparing estimates in early project phases (concept, feasibility).
Understanding of estimating principles, cost structures, and work breakdown systems (WBS).
Familiarity with project controls, cost engineering, and project delivery frameworks.
Desirable Attributes
Comfortable with managing uncertainty.
Works independently, self-driven, with independent, critical thinking.
Able to structure data to enable decision making.
Experience within a consulting or advisory environment.
Exposure to cost risk analysis, probabilistic estimating, or economic modelling.
Knowledge of market cost trends and supplier benchmarking across the APAC region.
Why Join Worley
Join a world leader in project delivery and consulting for the energy, chemicals, and resources sectors.
Work on diverse, high-value projects across the APAC region.
Collaborate with a global network of estimating, project controls, and technical experts.

Responsabilizarse por la realización y asignación de trabajos complejos o con alto nivel de dificultad, que impliquen un juicio independiente o criterio en relación con las labores de dibujo o modelamiento, para determinar un curso de acción de los proyectos, consistente con las políticas y metas funcionales establecidas por la organización.

Responzabilizarse por el trabajo producido y asegurase de que sea "correcto desde la primera vez".
Adaptarse al aprendizaje e implementación de nuevos conceptos con mayor complejidad.
Examinar los problemas cuidadosa y minuciosamente y comprender sus interdependencias para proponer soluciones

Software, procesos y herramientas:
*Capacidad de trabajar con escaneos láser y modelos 3D para lograr un diseño preciso de tuberías en entornos con restricciones, así como para integrar actualizaciones de modelos en consonancia con los materiales, las especificaciones y la información de la lista de líneas proporcionada por Piping Engineering.
* Minimo 12 años de experiencia desarrollando y actualizando entregables de diseño de tuberías, incluyendo planos de parcela, planos clave, diseños de equipos, disposiciones generales de tuberías (AG) e isométricos (manuales o extraídos).

* Capacidad para diseñar y enrutar tuberías en plataformas de diseño de plantas 3D como AVEVA E3D y AutoCAD Plant 3D.
* Conocimiento del código ASME B31.

Emplear los principios de la escucha activa y fomentar la retroalimentación desde y hacia los demás.

•    Adaptarse al aprendizaje e implementación de nuevos conceptos con mayor complejidad.

Experiencia mínimo 5 años en cargos similares y con manejo de Openroads

Responsable de aplicar políticas y procedimientos HSE en proyectos, asegurando el cumplimiento normativo y la mitigación de riesgos.

Comunicación efectiva con equipos de proyecto, contratistas y partes interesadas. Capacidad para informar y persuadir sobre asuntos complejos mediante presentaciones e informes.
Dominio de sistemas, procesos y herramientas HSE. Capaz de asistir a otros y resolver problemas técnicos.

Software, procesos y herramientas:
•    Certificación SERNAGEOMIN B (Idealmente. Supeditado a requisitos del cliente).

•    Experiencia específica: más de 6 años en el campo relacionado con el servicio ofrecido (EPCM) y en ejercicio de la profesión.

Posee habilidades analíticas, técnicas y de resolución de problemas, así como comprensión de las estrategias del equipo y las necesidades del cliente.

- Lugar:
Calama

8x6 o 4x3 (Por definir)

title: Piping Engineer Level I
description:
Construyendo sobre nuestro pasado. Listos para el futuro
Worley es una firma global de servicios profesionales compuesta por expertos en energía, productos químicos y recursos. Nos asociamos con clientes para entregar proyectos y crear valor durante la vida útil de sus activos. Estamos uniendo dos mundos, avanzando hacia fuentes de energía más sostenibles y al mismo tiempo ayudamos a proporcionar la energía, los productos químicos y los recursos que se necesitan ahora.
Objetivo del cargo:
Responsabilizarse por la realización y asignación de trabajos de ingeniería intermedios a complejos, debido a su capacidad, conocimiento intermedio, especialización y experiencia en el dominio de una o múltiples áreas de la ingeniería y de su disciplina en particular, además de otro tipo de productos y sistemas. Su trabajo está sujeto a prácticas y procedimientos, y puede requerir una revisión periódica. Dependiendo del requerimiento puede llegar a dirigir pequeños grupos en proyectos o equipos de trabajo.
Principales Responsabilidades:
Ser capaz de dar recomendaciones que incluirán soluciones completas dentro del alcance del trabajo de ingeniería, dibujo o modelamiento. Las decisiones inusuales y de alta complejidad normalmente se remiten a miembros de disciplina más senior.
Trabajar de forma autónoma permitiendo la planificación y organización de tareas en proyectos asignados, propias y de los integrantes de su equipo, en caso de dirigir uno.
Realizar sus funciones con base en una interacción y orientación técnica autoiniciada semanal a mensual con el supervisor, su trabajo generalmente no se supervisa en detalle y la cantidad de supervisión varía según la asignación.
Recibir, gestionar y llevar a cabo asignaciones relacionadas con proyectos de ingeniería con objetivos y prioridades específicas, considerando las áreas críticas que pueden afectar el trabajo de otras unidades. Por lo general, la orientación técnica está disponible para revisar sus programas de trabajo y asesorar sobre características inusuales de sus asignaciones.
Trabajar en equipos de hasta 4 personas que le reportan directamente, ya sea participando o liderando, y que pueden estar conformados por ingenieros y diseñadores de la misma disciplina, pero no tiene autoridad para las evaluaciones de desempeño que afectan el salario de otros profesionales.
Mantener una comunicación constante y efectiva con el equipo de trabajo, para informar y persuadir sobre asuntos complejos y problemas a través de la preparación y entrega de propuestas, presentaciones e informes, así como la colaboración con las partes interesadas y la gerencia de la disciplina.
Trabajar de manera competente y eficiente en herramientas de diseño especializado, análisis y modelado, y métodos centrados en datos interdisciplinarios.
Construir relaciones apropiadas, constructivas y efectivas en toda la organización; usar la diplomacia y el tacto, ser accesible, comunicarse con claridad, precisión y coherencia tanto verbalmente como por escrito. Emplear los principios de la escucha activa y fomentar la retroalimentación desde y hacia los demás.
Trabajar en un equipo con visibilidad para las partes interesadas en altos niveles, ser capaz de trabajar y vincularse con múltiples equipos y partes interesadas, ser capaz de priorizar las cargas de trabajo y ayudar a otros miembros del equipo a lograr sus objetivos.
Lograr los resultados establecidos por sí mismo y por otros, cumpliendo con los plazos establecido definidos.
Esforzarse por lograr objetivos ambiciosos, demostrando entusiasmo, persistencia y tenacidad.
Dividir y priorizar el trabajo en tareas ejecutables.
Responzabilizarse por el trabajo producido y asegurase de que sea "correcto desde la primera vez".
Adaptarse al aprendizaje e implementación de nuevos conceptos con mayor complejidad.
Examinar los problemas cuidadosa y minuciosamente y comprender sus interdependencias para proponer soluciones.
¿Qué traerás?
Software, procesos y herramientas:
Por lo general, tener más de 5 años de experiencia relevante en la disciplina y un conocimiento y comprensión competente de regulaciones, códigos, estándares de diseño y
fabricación, y prácticas estándar de la industria.
Adicionalmente puede tener conocimientos intermedios en la estimación de los costos de un proyecto y la redacción de contenidos de propuestas.
Tener experiencia en la realización de ingenierías conceptuales, básicas y detalladas de proyectos de la industria (Oil & Gas, Minería, Infraestructura, entre otros).
Conocimientos en ASME B31.3/B31.4/B31.8 codigos de tuberia.
Lugar: Bogotá (teletrabajo hibrido)
Nivel de Inglés: B2- C1
En caso de que necesites algún
ajuste de accesibilidad
por favor no dejes de aclararlo en tu postulación
Avanzando juntos
Estamos comprometidos a construir un lugar de trabajo diverso, inclusivo y respetuoso donde todos sientan que pertenecen, puedan hablar y ser escuchados. Brindamos igualdad de oportunidades de empleo a todos los solicitantes y empleados calificados sin importar edad, raza, credo, color, religión, sexo, origen nacional, ascendencia, estado de discapacidad, estado de veterano, orientación sexual, identidad o expresión de género, información genética, estado civil. estatus, estatus de ciudadanía o cualquier otra base protegida por la ley.
Queremos que nuestra gente esté llena de energía y poder para impulsar un impacto sostenible. Por eso, nos centramos en una cultura inspirada en valores que genere brillantez a través de la pertenencia, la conexión y la innovación.
Estamos construyendo un lugar de trabajo diverso, inclusivo y respetuoso. Crear un espacio donde todos sientan que pertenecen, puedan ser ellos mismos y ser escuchados.
Y no estamos hablando sólo de eso; lo estamos haciendo. Estamos recapacitando a nuestra gente, aprovechando habilidades transferibles y apoyando la transición de nuestra fuerza laboral para convertirse en expertos en la infraestructura y tecnología de energía baja en carbono de hoy.
Cualquiera que sea tu ambición, aquí hay un camino para ti. Y no existe ninguna barrera para el posible éxito profesional. Únase a nosotros para ampliar sus horizontes, explorar diversas oportunidades y ser parte del logro de un cambio sostenible.

Play an integral role in supporting Worley’s project delivery and commissioning activities by leading the management of subcontracts for commissioning and startup (CSU) phases. Managing all subcontracting activities related to commissioning and startup, from strategy development through contract closeout.

Administering post-award activities such as change orders, claims prevention, and contract closeout, maintaining full compliance with Worley policies and procedures.
Providing commercial guidance to CSU and project management teams, balancing risk and opportunity across multiple subcontracts.
Supporting the continuous improvement of subcontracting processes, systems, and tools to enhance efficiency and governance.
Mentoring and guiding junior team members, helping build capability in subcontract management across the organization.

A university degree in business, law, engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

description:

Work as part of a collaborative and inclusive team.

Right now, we’re bridging two worlds as we accelerate to more sustainable energy sources, while helping our customers provide the energy, chemicals and resources that society needs now.
We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their portfolio of assets. We solve complex problems by finding integrated data-centric solutions from the first stages of consulting and engineering to installation and commissioning, to the last stages of decommissioning and remediation. Join us and help drive innovation and sustainability in our projects.
The Role
As an Applications Technical Specialist with Worley,
you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
Solution Analysis:
Assist business representatives with the identification, assessment and documentation of new business requirements and system improvements. This includes those required for implementations into new entities and locations, and modifications for software upgrades.
Formulation, documentation and agreement of appropriate business solutions for consideration and approval by GBS Global Process Leads. In formulating solutions the Business Analyst should draw upon their operational experience, and be in close consultation with Oracle Functional Consultants (also known as Functional Leads or Functional Architects) and relevant representatives from the business.
For proposed solutions analyse impact of change and provide an estimate of implementation effort, operational costs and overall value to business, or where already provided by the business - a validation of those estimates.
Drawing on functional and technical expertise to formulate and agree appropriate business solutions for consideration and approval by IT and Business users. Working collaboratively with broader IT and business representatives to ensure quality outcomes.
Business cases for larger initiatives will need to be developed for senior stakeholder approval as required and will need to include business and IT inputs.
Assess impacts of improvements /changes across multiple lines and applications by liaising with business process owners and application custodians.
Technical Consultation:
Review and approval of functional specifications, as prepared by Oracle Functional Consultants for coding by Developers
(also known as Technical Consultants)
Preparation and validation of test scripts to be used for system testing, regression testing and user acceptance testing.
Review and approval of set-up and configuration documentation, as prepared by Oracle Functional Consultants
Coordinate Global UAT and sign off
User support:
Provide guidance and assistance to testers during system testing, regression testing and user acceptance testing.
Provide technical advice to the business
Deliver business user training.
Data Maintenance:
Coordinate/manage data maintenance activities on behalf of the business
Engage with senior location and regional stakeholders
Analyse impact of proposed actions
Clearance of Exceptions (legacy/aged)

Liderar la ejecución técnica de proyectos energéticos de gran envergadura. Esta posición será responsable de establecer el marco de trabajo de ingeniería, coordinar disciplinas, asegurar la integridad técnica y liderar al equipo de ingeniería en el cumplimiento de plazos, costos y requisitos de seguridad y sostenibilidad. El/la profesional ideal combinará habilidades de liderazgo, visión estratégica y profundo conocimiento técnico, gestionando equipos multidisciplinarios en entornos desafiantes y con alta visibilidad frente al cliente.

·
Definir y supervisar la estrategia de ejecución de ingeniería en proyectos asignados.
·
Liderar equipos multidisciplinarios de ingeniería (más de 100 personas).
·
Asegurar el cumplimiento de estándares de calidad, normativas legales y requisitos del cliente.
·
Coordinar con clientes, contratistas, proveedores y equipos internos.
·
Participar activamente en la planificación de proyectos, gestión de cambios, control de costos y
mitigación de riesgos.
·
Supervisar la generación de entregables técnicos clave y revisar su calidad.
·
Brindar soporte técnico a procesos de compras, construcción y puesta en marcha.
·
Impulsar una cultura de seguridad y sostenibilidad en todas las etapas del proyecto.
·
Actuar como referente técnico y mentor/a para los equipos de ingeniería.
Requerimientos:
·
20 años de experiencia general y 10 de experiencia en project delivery,en proyectos EPCM/EPC (Min $500 million size projects).
·
Formación: Profesional titulado de Ingeniería.
·

title: Service Now Platform Governance Manager
description:
Building on our past. Ready for the future
Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts. We partner with customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their assets. We’re bridging two worlds, moving towards more sustainable energy sources, while helping to provide the energy, chemicals and resources needed now.
Key Responsibilities
•    Lead knowledge management strategy and implementation, facilitating seamless access to information and continuous improvement.
•    Govern digital content and experiences to ensure accuracy, relevance, quality, and user-centric interactions.
•    Lead automation and AI-enabled self-service initiatives for efficient, independent issue resolution.
•    Develop and enforce governance frameworks, policies, and compliance standards across digital operations.
•    Drive strategic planning, design, and governance of the digital services catalog to enable self-service and automated request fulfilment objectives.
•    Establish and maintain a taxonomy framework for digital assets and services.
•    Ensure systematic categorization to improve discoverability and scalability.
•    Support consistent labeling, classification, and retrieval of digital content.
•    Adapt the taxonomy framework to evolving business needs and digital offerings.
•    Conduct regular reviews to align taxonomy with business objectives and user requirements.
•    Engage and align stakeholders across functions to support digital strategies and governance.
•    Analyze and optimize processes for improved service delivery and business performance.
•    Lead and empower cross-functional teams to deliver targeted service improvements, continuously advancing user-focused capabilities.
•    Leverage data analytics to drive informed decisions that enhance user experiences and business outcomes.
•    Establish and uphold configuration management frameworks designed to maximize business value
•    Create ROI by bringing in new features from SN platform to increase productivity and efficiency.
•    Champion rigorous user research to drive meaningful solutions
•    Prioritize, clarify, and guide the understanding of user stories, recommending the most effective tools and methods to deliver impactful, user-centric solutions.
•    Work with BA and development teams to bring the solutions to life
Required Qualifications and Experience
•    Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree or higher in Information Management, Computer Science, Digital Experience, or a closely related field.
•    Professional Experience: Minimum of 10 years in service management governance roles, with a proven track record of leading strategic planning, process optimization, and cross-functional digital initiatives on ServiceNow platform.
•    ServiceNow Expertise: Extensive, hands-on experience with the ServiceNow platform, including deep knowledge of its architecture, core modules, integration capabilities, and best practices for configuration management and service catalog design.
•    Methodologies: Strong familiarity with ITIL framework, Agile methodologies, and DevOps practices, with demonstrated ability to apply these frameworks to drive service improvements and business outcomes.
•    Certifications: ITIL V4 Foundation is required. ServiceNow CSA & CIS – ITSM will add advantages.
•    Analytical Skills: Ability to leverage data analytics to inform decision-making and enhance user experiences and business performance.
•    Stakeholder Engagement: Proven experience engaging, aligning, and influencing stakeholders across multiple functions to support digital strategies and governance.
•    Leadership: Demonstrated competency in leading and empowering cross-functional teams to deliver targeted, user-focused service improvements.
Remote Role from Colombia.

title: Principal Advanced Analysis Engineer
description:
About the job
We’re looking for a
Principal Advanced Analysis Engineer
to join our
Singapore
team.
When you work for us, you get the chance to join nearly 50,000 people all driven by a common purpose of delivering a more sustainable world. We’re excited about the challenges ahead. We believe there’s never been a more rewarding time to work in the energy, chemical and resources sectors.
We offer a flexible approach to working, because our people are safer, healthier, and more productive when they can balance work with life. That’s why there are flexible and hybrid working options, so you can choose when, where and how you work.
As a
Principal Advanced Analysis Engineer
, you will be responsible for developing numerical simulations using Finite Element Method (FEM) to support engineering and design of submarine pipelines. The numerical simulations may be in relation to global pipeline structural response, such as global buckling, pipeline walking, and/or local components analysis such as bulkhead stress analysis, etc.
Who we are
Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia.
Right now, we’re bridging two worlds as we accelerate to more sustainable energy sources, while helping our customers provide the energy, chemicals and resources that society needs now.
We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their portfolio of assets. We solve complex problems by finding integrated data-centric solutions from the first stages of consulting and engineering to installation and commissioning, to the last stages of decommissioning and remediation.
Join us and help drive innovation and sustainability in our projects.
What you’ll do
We are looking for a
Principal Advanced Analysis Engineer
to join our team in
Singapore
.
The role responsibilities include:
Support Sr. Principal engineer in using numerical methods to solve complex engineering problems by developing appropriate numerical simulations using Finite Element Method (FEM) with ABAQUS / ANSYS software.
Develop numerical models of pipeline and/or associated components using Finite Element Method (FEM) independently or with minimal guidance, including modelling of soil elements for pipe-soil-interaction simulations.
Perform numerical simulations for static and dynamic analysis based on the engineering requirements of submarine pipelines and associated components and, where necessary, develop sub-routines and scripts to optimise running time. The numerical simulations may include fracture, fatigue and impact assessment, modal analysis, etc. of the modelled pipeline and/or associated components.
Where applicable, the numerical simulations should be developed in compliance with international design codes for submarine pipelines and offshore structures, including DNVGL, API, ASME, etc.
Interpret and explain the results and findings of the simulations analyses. The results and findings should be explained with the fundamental engineering principals applicable in the design of submarine pipelines and associated subsea structures, including PLEM, PLET, etc.
What you’ll have
Knowledge and experience in numerical modelling with Finite Element Method (FEM) with 10 years of experience or longer in pipeline and structural components FEM analysis.
Ability to develop numerical models independently or with minimal guidance and, interpret and explain the results and findings of the simulation analyses.
Good knowledge and fundamental understanding on soil modelling, fracture mechanics, fatigue, damage and modal analysis to support various numerical simulations requirements.
Good working knowledge of ABAQUS / ANSYS software with the ability to develop user subroutines and scripts.
Fundamental understanding on engineering design of submarine pipelines and associated subsea structures, including PLEM, PLET, etc.
Fundamental understanding of international codes and standards for submarine pipelines and offshore structures, including DNVGL, ASME, API, ISO, etc.
Master or Doctorate (preferable) in Mechanical/ Civil Engineering and/or Materials Science.
Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in numerical modelling with Finite Element Method (FEM).

title: Field Engineer III
description:
Building on our past. Ready for the future
Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts. We partner with customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their assets. We’re bridging two worlds, moving towards more sustainable energy sources, while helping to provide the energy, chemicals and resources needed now.
Purpose of the Role
The Field Engineer I provides technical support for construction and engineering projects, contributing to Worley’s mission of delivering sustainable change. This entry-level role involves assisting in the preparation and review of designs, calculations, cost estimates, and material lists to ensure projects meet established codes, standards, and specifications. The position offers the opportunity to gain hands-on experience in field engineering within a global organization committed to accelerating the transition to more sustainable energy sources while continuing to deliver the resources the world depends on.
Key Responsibilities
Assist in preparing and adjusting simple plans, designs, plots, calculations, cost estimates, and bills of materials in compliance with project specifications and standards.
Support routine technical surveys, inspections, and field assessments, preparing reports to document findings and ensure construction aligns with design requirements.
Review completed construction tasks to confirm adherence to drawings, codes, and established engineering specifications.
Collaborate with supervisors, peers, and site teams to resolve basic technical issues and support project delivery.
Apply engineering principles and company processes to assigned tasks, gaining exposure to multidisciplinary project execution in the field.
Maintain accurate records and documentation to support project reporting, decision-making, and compliance.
Actively contribute to a strong safety culture by following site health, safety, and environmental requirements in all activities.
Develop knowledge of project systems, tools, and methodologies while contributing to continuous improvement in project delivery.
Communicate effectively with peers and supervisors to provide updates, share observations, and confirm alignment on assigned tasks.
Qualifications - Internal
Qualifications / Skillset
University degree in engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent trade qualification with relevant training and field-based experience.
Foundational knowledge of engineering principles, construction processes, and industry standards, with an eagerness to apply academic preparation to real-world projects.
Familiarity with technical drawing interpretation, material take-offs, and basic engineering calculations.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to accuracy and detail.
Ability to use Microsoft Office applications; exposure to CAD tools, engineering software, or project systems is advantageous.
Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in a team-based environment.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage routine tasks and follow established procedures.
Commitment to health, safety, and environmental practices consistent with Worley’s values and industry best practices.
Willingness to work under close supervision, accept feedback, and continuously develop technical knowledge and professional skills.
Alignment with Worley’s purpose of delivering a more sustainable world and ambition to grow within a global, sustainability-driven organization.

Installs machinery and equipment according to layout plans, blueprints and other drawings in establishments.

Reads and interprets blueprints, layout plans, vendor installation and operation manuals, and other schematic drawings to determine work procedures.

May install robot and modify its program using teach pendant.
May use transit and level for equipment setting.
Loads, transports and unloads materials, tools, equipment and supplies.
Performs lubricating maintenance, cleaning activities, or repair of tools, machines, and equipment.
Responsible for observing and complying with all safety and project rules.
Performs other duties as required.

title: Project Manager II, Worley Consulting, Digital
description:
Project Manager II, Worley Consulting Digital
Worley Consulting Group
Houston, Texas
Worley Consulting. Be part of the solution.
The dual challenge of supplying energy to a growing population, while addressing the risks of
climate change
, is one of the greatest challenges the world is facing today. The energy transition isn’t just about alternative fuels,
power
generation, or use, or
storage
. It’s all the elements that contribute to the energy ecosystem. We view these challenges as opportunities to deliver a more sustainable world.
We’re developing strategies and business cases for emissions intensive clients to move to low carbon energy options, as efficiently and safely as possible. Our consultants are advising customers on circular and
hydrogen
economies,
water
stewardship,
electrification
, and climate change risk and adaptation. We work on projects around the globe.  The problems our global and so are we.
Who we are:
Advanced Analysis
Asset Advisory
Decommissioning and Restoration
Energy Transition and Sustainability
Environment and Society
Geosciences
Market Services
Safety Consulting
Transport
, Infrastructure & Logistics
Water
Challenging complexity. Shaping a sustainable future.
Economic viability. Resource availability. Digital reliability. Carbon neutrality. These are the components of the world’s pressing energy and resource problems. Sound complicated and tough to balance?
It is.
Luckily we thrive in complex environments
Join a community of consultants, scientists, strategists, and engineers all dedicated to solving the world’s critical infrastructure, environmental, energy, and resource challenges. By seeing things from a different perspective, we enhance the Worley Group’s ability to serve our clients. We are together delivering a more sustainable world.
We put sustainability at the heart of everything we do
We work with business to develop the right strategy, log in to a digital future, secure and safeguard social license, enhance local communities, and power the energy transition.
We know we won’t solve today’s problems by using the same thinking that created them. So, from start to finish, we challenge ourselves to find the best way forward. We question every decision, assumption, and way of working to make sure we get it right. The first time.
Rising to the challenge, together
We are thousands of consultants across the globe.  Be part of the future – welcome to our growing team!
Overall Responsibilities and Key Accountabilities
Execution of project scope to a defined budget and schedule; manages and documents change orders, seeking customer approval prior to changes.
Ensures customer satisfaction with the agreed-upon deliverables.
Is accountable for office and site safety for the project team.
Recommends and selects the project team.
Manages mobilization to plan.
Assures all team members have the appropriate tools and equipment.
Mentors Project Engineers and junior team members.
Identifies and provides any specialized knowledge and training for the project team.
Evaluates team member performance.
Identifies opportunities to grow existing project scopes and expand service offerings.
Proactively seeks and develops new business opportunities within existing and adjacent markets.
Actively contributes to the PMO through process improvement, knowledge sharing, and governance support.
Travel as required for various field programs.
Qualifications - Internal
What you will bring:
Technical and Industry Experience:
Over 8 years’ experience managing projects or deploying advanced automation, instrumentation, and control in industrial settings.
Proven performance leading technical work as a Project Manager.
Demonstrated capabilities to build relationships with customers and other stakeholders.
Strong commercial acumen and experience in various commercial contracting models/risk profiles (Lump Sum/Fixed Price/Target Price/Reimbursable, etc.).
Proven experience in Waterfall and Agile project management.
Competent in MS Project, Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, Teams and PowerPoint.
Experience managing a portfolio of projects and working with clients for pull through work.
Motivational leadership style and strong communication skills with ability to develop high performance culture.
Ability to identify, quantify, and mitigate risks effectively through positive decision making.
Ability to manage project change effectively with project team and clients.
Capable of working with a diverse global project team working in an office and remotely.
Experience working in Oil & Gas, Chemicals, Renewables and Mining is an asset.
Must be located or willing to commute on a regular basis to Houston, Texas.
Willing to travel an average of 25%.
Education – Qualifications, Accreditation, Training:
Required:
A degree in either engineering, I&C, automation.
Additional Information:
The Project Manager, reporting to the Director, Business Operations & Execution, is responsible for leading and delivering digital projects across Canada, the US, and LATAM. These projects span key industries including Oil & Gas, mining, and other resource sectors, and are aligned with strategic business objectives and operational priorities.
This role involves managing all phases of project execution from planning and resourcing to delivery and closeout while ensuring alignment with budget, schedule, and quality standards. The Project Manager will oversee cross-functional teams, drive operational excellence, and support vertical P&L outcomes through disciplined execution and continuous improvement.
Success in this role requires strong project governance, stakeholder engagement, and collaboration across Worley Consulting and Base Business to develop integrated solutions. A key focus will be on expanding project scope, identifying opportunities for growth within existing engagements, and enhancing value delivery to clients. The Project Manager will also contribute to talent development, client satisfaction, and market responsiveness to support sustainable business growth across the region.
Worley Consulting offers an excellent remuneration & benefits package, a friendly, professional, dynamic and flexible work environment along with the opportunity to develop your career prospects locally and internationally.
